g.yon du chu rlung gi rang bzhin wa dkar po/ rgyab tu me rlung gi rang bzhin ra dmar po/ g.yas su rlung gi rang bzhin ya ljang khu/ dbus su nam mkha'i rlung gi rang bzhin thig le kha dog sngon po gcig bsams la/ rim gyis blo sbyang ba'i phyir dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i dus su mdun gyi la ser po las 'od zer kha dog ser po sbom phra skud pa 'bring bo tsam langs te gyen du phyung nas sna sgo g.yon pa nas phyung ste/ mdun du sor bcu drug tsam gyi tshad du byung bar bsam/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun la 'od zer de nang du bsdogs/ la ser po de la bstims la yid kyis sa ser po de la blta zhing rlung kha sbyar gyis dmigs pa bya'o/ /des du ba lta bu'i rtags mthong ba de'i tshe sa rlung dbang du gyur pa'i rtags yin pas la ser po de dag g.yon gyi wa dkar po la bstim/ wa dkar po las 'od zer dkar po sna bug g.yon pa nas 'byung ba dang / 'jug pa dang rlung gi rnal 'byor dang bcas pa snga ma bzhin bsgoms pas smig sgyu lta bu mthong ba de'i tshe chu rlung dbang du 'dus pas/ wa dkar po de rgyab kyi ra dmar po la bstim/ ra dmar po las 'od zer dmar po sna g.yon nas byung pa dang / 'jug pa dang rlung gi rnal 'byor snga ma bzhin du bsgoms pas srin bu me khyer lta bu'i rtags mthong ba de'i tshe me rlung dbang du 'dus pa yin pas ra dmar po de g.yas kyi ya ljang khu la bstims la bzhag ya de las 'od zer ljang khu sna g.yon nas 'byung ba dang / 'jug pa dang / rlung gi rnal 'byor snga ma bzhin du bsgoms pas mar me 'bar ma lta bu'i rtags mthong ba de'i tshe rlung gi rlung dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags yin pas yi ge ya ljang khu de dbus kyi thig le sngon po la bstims la bzhag de nas thig le sngon po las 'od zer 'byung 'jug med par thig le la yid kyis lta zhing rlung kha sbyar pa'i rnal 'byor pas nam mkha' sprin med lta bu mthong ba de'i tshe nam mkha'i rlung dbang du 'dus pa yin pas/

'di'i mjug tu mthong ba'i lam gyi ye shes skye zhes gsungs so/ /yi ge bsdu ba'o/ /thig le bsdu ba ni yi ge rnams kyi shul du thig le bsgom pa ste/ shar du thig le ser po/ g.yon du dkar po/ rgyab tu dmar po/ g.yas su ljang khu rnams bsgom la/ 'od zer gyi skud pa'i 'byung 'jug dang / rlung dang rlung gi rnal 'byor la sogs pa snga ma'i tshul du bsgoms pas mthar phyin pa'i tshad snga ma bzhin du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /des na 'di gnyis kyang rnal 'byor pa rang gi blo la gang bde ba bsgom pa yin la/ gcig gi rjes la gcig bsgom pa ni ma yin no/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan zin te rim pa gnyis kyi mngon par rtogs pa gtso bo rnams bstan zin to zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa dag pa rjes su dran pa ni/ slob dpon gyi gzhung las/ so dang sen mo dag la ni/ khaṇḍa ka pā li'o/ /zhes pa nas/ dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di dang kun spyod le'u bco lnga pa las/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyi dpa' bo gang / /tshangs pa'i skud pa la sogs brtag /lha yi snying po'i gsang sngags kyis/ /zla phyed phreng bas brgyan pa yin/ /dpa' bo'i go cha drug gi ni/ /rgya 'dis lus ni mdzes pa yin/ /rdo rje phag mo sogs sngags gang / /mgur chus ske ba mdzes pa yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /lpags pa'i gos ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /kha ṭwaṃ ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍa ma ru ru brtag /thod pa'i dum bu lag sogs kun/ /lus kyi khams lnga rnam par brtag /yi ge bdun ni gsang sngags kyi/ /rna chas snyan ni mdzes pa yin/ /rnal 'byor ma dag gsang sngags gang / /ske rags byas pa brgyan pa yin/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i/ /sngags ni lag pa'i thod pa yin/ /rnam par snang mdzad yum sngags gang / /thod pas mgo bo brgyan pa yin/ /de ltar bdag nyid rnam gnas nas/ /tsham ngam sngags kyis legs par bsrungs/

/rtag tu tshangs par spyod 'gyur ba/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis mchod/ /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo ste/ /mtshan mo bcom ldan ma brtag bya/ /mi bya ci yang yod min te/ /rtag tu mi bsam yod ma yin/ /mi za ci yang yod min la/ /dge dang mi dge mi smra med/ /bdag nyid ji bzhin 'gro ji bzhin/ /bdag ci 'dra ba gzhan de bzhin/ /de ltar rnam bsam rnal 'byor bdag /'jigs pa thams cad yongs spangs te/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed yin/ /zhes pas bstan/ 'di dag gi don rje btsun gyis/ de yang gtor ma'i rjes la 'byung ba ni rjes spyod kyi rnal 'byor du yang 'gro la/ rim pa gnyis kho na'i rjes la 'byung ba ni stan gcig gi steng du brjod pa yin pa'i phyir mnyam gzhag gi khongs su 'du ba yin no/ /de yang lag tu len par 'dod na/ gtor ma gtang ba'am/ ma btang yang rung ste/ mnyam gzhag bsgom pa'i stan de las ma langs par/ lus kyi ḍa ma ru'i sgra dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang btub ste/ ngag tu 'og nas 'byung ba rnams gsal bar brjod cing / sems kyis ma dag pa'i khams dang / rgyan cha la sogs pa de dang de dag dag pa'i lha dang / sngags de dang de'i ngo bo yin snyam du mos pa bya ba yin gyi/ lha dang sngags kyi rnam par bsgom pa ni mi dgos so zhes gsungs te/ ji ltar brjod pa'i tshul ni mngon par rtogs pa ltar ro/ /'og gi kha ṭwaṃ ka ni lha yi sku/ /zhes sogs tshig bcad gcig gis spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang / sprul pa las byung dpa' bo rnams/ /zhes sogs kyis de dag gi rgyu mtshan ston par 'grel pas bshad do/ /gsum pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la zhes pa nas/ sa ha yi bha wan tu hūm̐ phaṭ ces pa'i bar bzlas pa'i gtor sngags dang / de nyid lan lnga brjod pas 'bul tshul dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor sngags tsam zhig gsungs la/

de nyid kun spyod le'u bcu pa las kyang gsungs so/ /de dag gi don la lnga ste/ gtor ma gtang ba'i dus dang / yo byad dang / cho ga dang / gtong tshul dang / dgos pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ rgyun gyi dus ni/ mngon brjod las/ cho ga 'di yi rim pa yis/ /thun mtshams bzhi ru sbyin par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa khyad par kyi dus ni/ kun spyod le'u bcu pa las/ zla ba mar ngo'i tshes bcu dang / /zla ba yar ngo'i de nyid la/ /zhes dang / dgun zla 'bring po la sogs pa'i/ /tshes bcu la ni dad pas tshod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa yo byad ni/ le'u de nyid las/ myur du 'bad pas sha dang chang dag gis/ /rdo rje lha mo rab tu mchod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa cho ga la 'das pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gnyis ka'ang mngon par rtogs pa'i dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin no/ /bzhi pa gtong tshul ni/ le'u de nyid las/ lho phyogs kha bltas rnal 'byor pas/ /gnas ni mthon por rab tu mchod/ /mtshan mo skra ni grol gyur pas/ /brtul zhugs gos med gtor ma sbyin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa dgos pa ni le'u de nyid las/ de yi lag tu 'ongs pa'i dpal/ /gang gis kyang ni gzhom mi nus/ /de ni skye bo dad ldan rnams kyis mchod/ /he ru ka dpal mngon par rgyas gyur nas/ /kun dgyes pa yi mchog ni gsol gyur te/ /gang phyir mchog ni de yi lag na gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar gtor ma btang nas/ de nas dpa' bo'i go cha dang / dpa' mo'i go cha dang / go cha chen po dang / zhal bzhi pa'i tsham ngam sngags kyi bsrung ba spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dran pa tsam bya'o/ /bzhi pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ kha zas gtor ma bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin reg nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs la/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyi g.yon gyi kun tu spyod pas longs spyad par bya'o/

/de yang rgyas par na lag mchod tshul bzhin bya/ de tsam ma grub na/ dkon mchog dang 'byung po'i phud kyi bya ba gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ de nas bdag gi lus phyi'i he ru ka la/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor yin par mos pa dang / khyad par du lte ba nas me 'bar ba'i khrod/ snying gar me'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das he ru ka yab yum tsam mam/ lha bcu gsum tsam mam/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad rdzogs pa gang rung gsal por dmigs la kha sbyin sreg gi thab khung / lus ni lha'i dkyil 'khor/ lag pa ni gzar bu/ kha zas ni bsreg rdzas su bsam la/ lha mchod pa'i bsam pas thog mar lag pa g.yon pas longs spyod par bya'o/ /de ltar kha zas kyi rnal 'byor tshul bzhin du byas pa'i rjes su/ lhag ma'i gtor ma yang tshul bzhin bya'o/ /rim gnyis brtan par bya ba'i spyod pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma'i kun spyod dang / slob dpon gyi gzhung gnyis ka las/ dag pa dran pa'i rjes su gzhung cung zad cig 'byung bas/ de brjod na rang don gyi spyod pa dang / gzhan don gyi spyod pa gnyis/ dang po la bskyed rim brtan par byed pa spros bcas kyi spyod pa dang / rdzogs rim brtan par byed pa spros med kyi spyod pa gnyis/ dang po ni 'byor pa dang bcas pas kun tu spyod na bskyed pa'i rim pa cung zad brtan pa/ des tshogs kyi khang pa gsum rim brtsigs la/ nang du lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi 'bag dang nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo drug cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa'i tshul du bkod la/ thams cad kyis kyang mngon par rtogs pa tshul gcig tu bsgom/ rim pa gnyis pa la rdo rje ma drug gi nga rgyal 'dzin pa grangs ci rigs pa bkod la/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i kha zas kyi g.yos byas shing thun mtshams su phyi nang na gnas pa rnams la tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i ston mo drang bar bya'o/

/rim pa tha ma la glu len pa dang / gar byed pa la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor rig ma bcu drug gi nga rgyal 'dzin cing dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa bkod do /de lta bu'i tshul gyis thun bzhi'am drug tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya zhing / lo'am zla ba du mar bsgrubs nas bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dmigs pa shin tu brtan par byed pa yin no/ /yo byad dang 'byor pa de tsam med pas rang nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas rgyan drug bgos la/ ḍa ma ru dang / kha ṭwaṃ ka dang / thod pa 'dzin pas thun drug gam gsum du bskyed rim brtan par bya zhing bsgom mo/ /rdzogs rim brtan par byed pa spros med kyi spyod pa ni/ mnyam gzhag gi dus su 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa snyam byed na/ de brtan nam mi brtan brtag pa'i don du mtshan mo lam ka'i bzhi mdo la sogs par phyin te/ yul rnams nye bar longs spyad nas rnam par rtog pa skye'am mi skye brtag cing brtan par byed pa yin no/ /nyin mo'i dus su bram ze la sogs pas rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i spyod pas gnas par bya ba yin no/ gnyis ka brtan par byed pa shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa ni/ spros med kyi spyod pas tha mal gyi rnam rtog mi skye bar nges par brtan pa dang / rang gi yul 'khor yongs su spangs te/ rang gi rigs dang / rus dang / cho 'brang la sogs pa thams cad gsang nas smyon par brdzus te/ smyon pa'i sbyor bas rang gi rtogs pa'i ye shes kun tu skyong zhing brtan par byed pa yin no/ /gzhan gyidon gyi spyod pa ni/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pas ye shes shin tu brtan nas nus pa chen po skyes pa de'i tshe sems can thams cad rjes su bzung ba'i spyod pas rnal 'byor par khas blangs nas/ slob dpon birwa pa'am/ slob dpon lū hi pa bzhin du gzhan don gyi spyod pa byed pa yin no/ /de la slob dpon lū hi pa'i dgongs pa jo bo na ro ta pas bskangs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa 'di/

sku gsum lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs yin te/ de yang blo'i spyod yul rdzogs pa gcig la sku gsum du bzhag pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs pa gcig la sku gsum du bzhag pa dang / mngon par rtogs pa gcig la sku gsum du bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni bdag gi blo snang gi dkyil 'khor ni zhing skyes kyis sprul la/ zhing skyes nyid kyang lhan skyes kyis sprul pa'i phyir/ de gnyis ka'ang sprul pa'i sku'o/ /lhan skyes ni gnas 'pho ba med pa'i tshul gyis zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang / chos la longs spyod pa'i phyir longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o/ /chos kyi sku ni chos kyi sku nyid do/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs pa gcig la sku gsum du 'jog pa na/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo ni chos kyi sku/ 'khor lo gsum ni longs sku/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni sprul pa'i sku'o/ /mngon par rtogs pa rdzogs pa gcig la sku gsum du 'jog na/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor dag pa dang bcas pa sprul pa'i sku lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa dang bcas pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa spyod pa dang bcas pa chos kyi sku lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /de la 'bring bsdus gnyis kyi dbang du byas na phyi'i dkyil 'khor med pas/ lus la lha rnams rdzogs par bskyed pa tsam ni sprul pa'i sku yin la/ bskyed pa gsal gdab pa dang / thim pa'i tshul gyis longs spyod pa ni longs spyod pa'i sku yin la/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa spyod pa dang bcas pa ni chos kyi sku lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /bzhi pa de ltar bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu la gsum ste zhes sogs bya ba dman pa'i dngos grub dang / 'bring grub pa chen po brgyad dang / mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub dang / rab phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sku gsum gyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas kyi sa rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid 'grub pa yin no/

/de la mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub gzhung las/ 'pho ba'i tshe na rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes pa nas/ mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed/ /ces pa'i bar te/ kun spyod le'u bcu bdun pa las/ rnal 'byor pa ni 'pho ba'i tshe/ /dpal ldan he ru ka la sogs/ /dpa' bo dang ni thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni ji snyed pa/ /lag na me tog sna tshogs bsnams/ /ba dan rgyal mtshan sna tshogs dang / /rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / /sna tshogs glus ni nye bar mchod/ /'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog de/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khyer/ /de ltar dpa' bo chen po dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni sa steng dkon/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don du snang ngo / /gal te mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang 'chi khar ma thob na 'khor los bsgyur ba la sogs pa mtho ris kyi rten la lam lhag ma rnams bgrod par byed de/ de nyid las/ bsam gtan gyis ni bsam tsam 'am/ /'dod cing klog gam bris pa yis/ /mtho ris longs spyod thob 'gyur te/ /yang na 'khor los bsgyur nyid 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rab phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub ni/ rje btsun gyi kun spyod le'u bcu gsum pa las/ bstan pa yi ni sprul pa yin/ /bshad pas longs spyod rdzogs par 'dod/ /so sor bstan pa ma lus nyid/ /mya ngan 'das pa de nyid bstan/ /sku gsum 'khor lo gsum du bshad/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul mtshan nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar sku gsum la bzhed de/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar glo bur gyi dri ma ma lus pa dang bral ba'i tshe snang ba'i dngos po thams cad bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor sdom pa ni chos kyi sku dang / de nyid 'og min du gdul bya dag pa rnams la lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du shar ba ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / de nyid gdul bya grub pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams la sprul pa mchog gi dkyil 'khor du shar nas/

rigs can gsum la shākya thub pa la sogs pa dang / ri bong dang / stag dang / seng ge dang / gzings dang zam pa la sogs pa'i rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pas sems can gyi don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa ni sprul pa'i skur bzhed cing / de dag gis 'phrin las thams cad kyang sku gsum gyi 'phrin las yin par bzhed do/ /de dag gi ni grub chen lū hi pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs bshad pas bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa grub chen nag po pa lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs bshad pa la/ rje btsun bla ma mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi gsung las ji ltar zin pa bzhin brjod par bya ste/ de la yang / gang gis bsgom pa ba'i rten gyi gang zag gang du bsgom pa gnas kyi rnam gzhag nam bsgom pa'i dus kyi rnam gzhag ji ltar bsgom pa'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag go /dang po ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud legs par sbyangs te/ 'gro ba'i don du rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang myur du thob par 'dod pas/ bka' srol 'di pa'i lugs kyi dbang legs par thob ste rgyud smin par byas pa/ smin pa ma nyams pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa/ gnas nas nyams len gyi don rnams bla ma las thob ste/ thob pa'i don la nges shes rnyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ grub chen 'di nyid kyi dkyil chog las/ 'jam zhing snyan par smra ba dang / /snying rje la sogs phan sems ldan/ /thos dang klog la mngon par brtson/ /gsang pa'i chos la lhag par dad/ /rtag par rgyun du bla ma gus/ /slob ma de ni yongs su bzung / /zhes bya ba'i don ni/ bshad sbyar du/ 'jam pa ni lus kyi spyod pa ngag snyan par smra ba/ byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba snying rje la sogs pa tshad med gsum dang byang chub kyi sems gsum ste mdor na phan sems dang ldan pa ste byang chub sems dpa' dang sems dpa' chen po'o/

/pha rol tu phyin pa la thos pa che zhing klog pa la brtson pa/ gsang ba'i chos rdo rje theg pa'i spyod pa la lhag par dad pa/ lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma la gus pa'i slob ma bzung zhes gsungs pas/ smin grol gnyis las smin lam gyi snod du gyur pa la mtshan nyid de dag ldan dgos zhes pa'o/ /rgyas par mdo bstan bcos man ngag dam pa gzhan gyis brgyan te bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni grol lam gyi snod du 'gyur ba de tsam gyis kyang mi chog cing dbang gis legs par smin pa dgos te/ phyag chen thig ler/ dang po re zhig slob ma la/ /dbang rnams lan cig bskur ba yi/ /de tshe gsang chen bshad pa yi/ /nges par snod du gyur pa'o/ /zhes dang / sgron gsal las/ dngos grub thams cad ni dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nyid las 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ dbang yang rgyud gzhung dang bka' 'di nyid las legs par thob dgos te/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs la/ /ming tsam bstan par mi bya ste/ /dkyil 'khor gzhan du zhugs pa la/ /'di yi gsang ba bstan mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dang rgyu mtshan rnams legs par bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar smin pa tsam gyis kyang mi chog ste/ slar mi nyams shing dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pa la gnas dgos te/ rtsa rgyud le'u dang por shin tu mnyam gzhag sgrub pa pos/ /dam tshig rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /dam tshig nyams pas dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dngos grub 'dod pas sgo gsum bsgrims te/ dran shes bzhin brten dgos/ gal te dam tshig dang 'gal te ltung ba byung na dbang bskur ba'i nus pa nyams te/ de'i stobs kyis dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur/ phran tshegs thob kyang nyams pa'i dbang gis rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur bas bsrung bar bya'o/

/dam tshig kyang bzhi ste/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig za ba'i dam tshig mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig bsgrub pa'i dam tshig go /dang po la thun mong dang / thun mong min pa gnyis te/ dang po ni/ dkyil chog tu/ che ge dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid gnyis med la gnas bar/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med la/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung / /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ bshad sbyar du/ bdag gis sdom pa bzung ba'i dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid gnyis med sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar/ nag nog gi dri ma med pas/ tshangs spyod mtha' gnyis 'gog nus pa'i kun rdzob dang / don dam byang chub sems gnyis zung du chud pas gnyis med/ 'jug pa'i bdag nyid rtsa ba bcu bzhi dang yan lag brgyad de nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyis ma gos par legs par bsrung zhes pa'o/ /de dag gi don ni/ rje btsun gyi 'khrul pa spong ba chen po la rag las pas der blta'o/ /gnyis pa la/ spyir g.yon pa'i kun spyod/ khyad par bud med la ma gus pa spang ba/ nying dgos su rang gi shes rab ma dang 'brel ba brgyad do/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud nyer brgyad par/ 'jig rten las rtag g.yon nas spyod/ /rkang pa g.yon pa sngon la dor/ /lag pa g.yon pa sngon du bsgyur/ /g.yon gyi spyod pas rab mchod byed/ /lus kyi g.yon ni rnam par 'khri/ /g.yon pa yis ni tshim par bza'/ /zhes gsungs shing de'i phan yon yang rtsa rgyud las/ skyes pa bud med g.yon pas 'gro /'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar byed/ /khyim dang zhing na rnam gnas pa'i/ /shin tu ring yang shes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ yang rgyud las/ khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu bar/ /'gro kun g.yon las byung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ g.yon pa'i spyod pa shes rab ste/ /g.yas pa de bzhin thabs yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ he ru ka mngon byung du/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung g.yon pas spyod/ /sgrub po sa steng sa 'og na/

/bzlas dang brtul zhugs bral bas kyang / /g.yon pas dngos grub 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ chos thams cad shes rab bdag med pa'i don dran pa las skad cig kyang ma g.yos par bya'o/ /'di ni spyir theg chen khyad par du gsang sngags kyi dam tshig yin la/ 'di pa'i lugs kyi kun spyod thams cad 'di'i chos can du rig par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ phyag rgya dang bral gsang sngags ni/ /lus can rnams la 'grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes dgag pa dang / pho nya'i lam la dga' rnams kyi/ /sgrub pa po ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ gus pa byed tshul yang / bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing / /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang / /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /ces gsungs/ phan yon yang / rtsa rgyud nyer drug par/ mos dang dad pa 'phel byed pa/ /rtag par dngos grub rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pas de dag phal cher bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ lha mo gzhan dang kun sbyor ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rang gi rtags sbyangs byas pa bor nas/ ma byas pa bsten na dam tshig nyams so/ /'dod la chags par 'gyur 'gro ba/ /zhes pas 'dod pa la chags pas/ de la 'gro bar byed na dam tshig nyams so/ /mi g.yo bdag gzhan gnyis med pa/ /zhes pas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid las mi g.yo bas/ bdag gzhan gnyis med du rtogs pa'i de kho na nyid dang bral bas bsten na dam tshig nyams so/ /gnyis su med dang thogs pa med/ /ces pas pho nya ma bzang ngan gnyis su med pa dang / bzang ngan la thogs pa med pas ma shes na dam tshig nyams so/ /dang po ni dngos su blang dor byas pa yin la/ 'di ni blang dor gyi bsam pas stong pa la bzhag pas zlos skyon med do/ /dam tshig spyod pa spyad par bya/ /zhes pa don gyi bzhi pa rtogs par bya ba'i bsam pas spyad par bya yis/ de dang bral ba'i bsam pas bsten na bral lo/ /bud med dbang phyug shin tu sbyar/

zhes pas ma dang sring mo la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya bsten pa las bzlog na'o/ /tshangs spyod de bzhin bsam gtan gnas/ zhes pas tshangs spyod ni/ byang sems nor bu'i rtse las mi 'pho ba ste/ de la mi tshangs pa spyod pa med pas so/ /bsam gtan gnas ni/ dpa' bo gcig pas mi chog pas/ dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la rtse gcig gnas pa'o/ /khro med rgyud du kun tu spyod/ /ces pa ni/ gzhan gyi gnod pa'i rgyu rkyen dang 'phrad kyang rang rgyud la khro ba med pa'i kun spyod la gnas pa'o/ /'di brgyad dam tshig kun spyod yin/ /zhes rtsa rgyud nyer drug par bshad do/ /nyer bdun par/ pho nya ral gri'i so 'dra zhing / /dag byed bsod nams 'phel byed yin/ /zhes bsten tshul la sogs pa'i phan yon bshad do/ /bsten pa'i rten ni/ khyim pa dang rab byung gnyis las phyi ma ni/ de nyid rig pa nyes pa med/ /ces gsungs pas/ bden pa mthong bas bstan pa la smod pa'i dgag bya med na brten par gsungs so/ /slob dpon kha cig rtse mo'am/ bzod pa thob na de nyid rig par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa bza' ba'i dam tshig la/ rgyun dang khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig gnyis las/ dang po la bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i tshul/ grub pa dam tshig tu bsten pa'i tshul/ bsten pa'i phan yon dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u dang por/ sbrang rtsi mtshal dang ga pur bcas/ /dmar po tsandan sbyar ba ni/ /zhes pas rdzas bstan te/ sbrang rtsi ni dri chu/ mtshal ni rakta/ ga pur byang sems bcas kyi dri chen/ dmar po tsandan gyi sha chen rnams dngos su bstan no/ /sgrub pa'i tshul ni/ tshogs kyi nang du gzhag bya ba/ /rdo rje kun mtshan mtshan ma 'dzin/ /zhes pas bsgrub pa'i dus dang cho ga mtshon nas bstan no/ /lag len dngos ni rje btsun dang 'phags pa'i yig cha'i steng nas mthong ba brgyud pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni sbom po mtha' ltag rtse sbyar bas/

/rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu spyad/ /zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs na/ /zhes pas bstan/ sbom po mtha' ltag mtheb srin rtse mo sbyar bas lce'i steng du bzhag su yis na/ rnal 'byor rig pa ste/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i cho ga rig pa'i sgrub pa po yis so/ /rtag tu spyad ni/ rab thun bzhi'i thog mtha' re re ste brgyad/ 'bring thun mgo la re re ste bzhi bzhi/ tha ma thun dang po la gcig bzhag la bsten pa'o/ /de yang ma grub na zla ba re re la re re bsten/ de'ang ma grub na zla ba drug la re re/ de'ang ma grub na dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu gnyis la re re bsten no/ /zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs na/ /zhes te/ zhi ba lha yin la/ de la lha'i bdud rtsi myang ba bzhin du reg pa'i dus dal bar myang / lce'i steng du ro phyin par myang / yun ring bar ma yengs par zhi rgyas la sogs pa las gang bsgrub pa la dmigs te myang ba'o/ /gsum pa phan yon ni/ kam pa las/ 'di lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam dang 'gyur/ /dngos grub rtag pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ bcud len des rdo rje'i lus thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang / nyon mongs pa lnga dang nad lnga zhi ba dang sel/ bar chad thams cad zhi/ mkha' 'gro thams cad 'du bas byin gyis rlob pa'o/ /de dag gang gi nus pa yin na/ 'di ni mi 'chi bcu phyed 'gyur/ /dngos grub thams cad 'jug byed yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mi 'chi ba ni bdud rtsi yin la/ bcu phyed ni bdud rtsi lnga ste/ de myangs pa'i nus pa'o/ /gzhan yang dngos grub gnyis po thams cad thob pa'i grogs su 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ de la rten gyi sgo nas skyes pa kho na tshogs pa la dpa' bo'i ston mo dang / bud med kho na tshogs la dpa' mo'i ston mo dang / gnyis ka 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo ste gsum/ dus kyi sgo nas dbang bskur ba/

rab tu gnas pa/ rgyud don zab mo 'chad pa sogs kyi tshe ni/ dga' ston tsa ru'i bza' ba'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas mdza' ba 'dus pa'i ston mo dang / gtso bo bdag bskyed kyi sgo nas mchod pa dang / gtso bo mdun bskyed kyi sgo nas mchod pa'o/ /dgos pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi gar/ mchod yul gyi sgo nas rigs ldan ma mchod pa dang / gzhon nu ma'i ston mo ltar ro/ /khyad par 'dir tshes bcu gnyis gsal te/ tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ /ces gsungs/ phyag bzhes ni/ rje btsun gyi tshogs 'khor 'bring po ste/ de yang shin tu gsal bar byas pa gsang ba kun rgyan dang / bde chen rnam rol zhes pa rje btsun kun dga' bzang po pas mdzad pa 'di'i log rtog gi dri ma sel ba dang bcas pa/ sa paṇa gyis tshogs 'khor rtsod spongs rnams las nges shes rnyed par bya'o/ /de ltar byas pa'i phan yon yang / sa paṇa gyi mkhan po kha che ba'i zhal nas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs la bsam pas bsdus pa la byang chub kyi sems dang / sbyor bas bsdus pa bskyed rim zab mo dang 'brel ba'i tshogs 'khor che bar gsungs te/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ rgyud kyi mthar thug pa dpal ldan 'dus pa/ 'khrul 'khor gyi mthar thug pa gshin rje'i gshed skor/ spyod pa'i mthar thug pa bde mchog sangs rgyas thod pa/ bsod nams kyi mthar thug pa tshogs kyi 'khor lor bshad ces dang mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang / sgyu ma bde mchog kye rdo rje/ /gang du zos pas 'dod don kun/ /bsgrub pa can gyi dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te mtha' yas so/ /gsum pa mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig la shin tu mang bar gsungs na'ang / gtso bor gyur pa sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig rdzas gsum ste/ sku'i dam tshig tu rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin gyi bris sku rab gnas can/

gsung gi dam tshig tu rgyud nas gsungs pa ltar gyi rgyud kyi glegs bam sbrang chen gyi snag tshas bris pa dkyus su sor bcu gnyis/ zheng du sor bzhi pa rab gnas can no/ /thugs kyi dam tshig tu rdo rje dril bu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rab gnas can no/ /de dag kyang dam tshig dang mi ldan pas ma mthong ba dgos te/ sgyu ma bde mchog tu/ glegs bam dang ni bris sku nyid/ /gal te skal med kyis mthong na/ /skye ba 'dir ni dngos grub med/ /'jig rten pha rol spyod yul min/ /zhes gsungs pas gsang zhing sbas nas 'chang ngo / /de dag dgos pa med par zhag gcig kyang 'bral du med la/ dgos pa'i dbang gis zhag drug pa'i mtshan mo'i mtha' tshun chad du 'bral bar snang ste/ nyan thos dag tu rlom byed pa'i/ /nang du zhag bdun gnas pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i rigs pas shes gsungs/ bzhi pa bsgrub pa'am/ bsten pa'i dam tshig la yang shin tu mang bar shes par dgos na'ang / gtso bor lam rim gnyis bsgom pa ste/ 'di'ang dus skad cig kyang rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i rtog pa las ma g.yos pa'o/ /tha na'ang thun drug tu bsgom pa gcig dgos te/ 'di nye bar 'khor gyi mdo dpang du byas na/ byang chub kyi sems la thun drug dgos la/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsung dpang du byas na'ang 'dir thun drug nges par dgos te/ rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan drug tu/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /zhes dang / nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin yang bzlas par bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i dam tshig gi tshogs ni dngos grub thams cad kyi gzhi yin pa la nges shes bskyed/ khyad par las dang po pa'i bsrung ba'i dam tshig la dgos pa gal che zhing / de la blang dor shes pa'i phyir/

rje btsun gyi 'khrul spong gi mgo mjug bar gsum du gsungs pa'i dgongs don rnams la nges pa'i shes pa gting thag pa nas bsams nas dran par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ de ltar dam tshig la gnas nas gang nyams su blang bya'i chos la thos bsam gyi sgo nas nges shes rnyed pa dgos te/ rtsa rgyud so gnyis par/ de nas rtag tu sgrub pa pos/ /sngags kyi lha ni shes nas bsgom/ /de lta bu yi khyad par gyis/ /sgrub pa po ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rtsa rgyud las/ rang rgyud sngags dang rnal 'byor shes/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyud gzhan las/ gsang ba'i de nyid mi shes pas/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ thos bsam yang rang gi gzhung rnams la bltas pa tsam gyis mi shes/ shes kyang byin rlabs mi 'ongs pas/ bla ma la ltos dgos te/ dpal kha sbyor las/ gsang don de nyid dngos po yang / /gcig nas gcig brgyud shes par bya/ /bla ma rab kyi zhal las blangs/ /zhes gsungs/ shradhas/ dang por nyan pa'i shes rab kyis/ /tshig gis rgyud la thos pa bskyed/ /de nas bsam pa'i shes rab kyis/ /tshig dang don la 'brel par bslab/ /de nas bsgom pa'i blo rtsal gyis/ /dang por bskyed pa'i rim la bslab/ /de nas rdzogs pa mthar dbyung ste/ /kha phub rdol dang dug can gyi/ /skyon rnams spangs te rgyun bsgoms na/ /chu lud rkyen gyis 'bras bskyed bzhin/ /'bras bu mngon 'gyur the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pas rten gyi gang zag ni mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa zhig dgos shing / grub chen gyi gzhung las/ 'jigs bral yongs su dag pa'i blos/ /ma lus rnam rtog phar bsal te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa'i 'jigs pa dang bral ba/ de'i steng du bskyed rim bsgom pa'i blo dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang / gcig tu sems can gdug cing gtum zhes sogs gsungs pas/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub kyi sems kyi/ rgyud sbyangs pa/

nag po dkyil 'khor gyi cho gas dbang legs par bskur ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa de sgom pa po'i rten gyi gang zag go /gnyis pa ni/ a bhi dha na las/ gnas ni brtag pa byas pa'am/ /yid ni gang du dga' gyur pa/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo sdom pa yis/ /dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi blos brtags te/ gang du nad gzhi la sogs pa mi bskyed pa/ dgra jag chom rkun la sogs pas dben zhing / mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub pa'i gnas mchog tu gyur pa'am/ yang na rang gi yid dang mthun pa der sdod snying 'dod cing bag phebs pa blo bde ba nyams dga' ba'i gnas me tog dang 'bras bu la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa/ 'bab chu dang skyed mos tshal la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dga' zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas gnyis gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i gnas su bsam gtan gyi khang bu/ lang / na mgo bo mi thug pa/ brkyangs na rkang pa mi thug pa/ 'dom shad brkyang / na shong ba/ phyin na gom gsum 'dor thub pa'i khang bu'i nang du chag chag btab/ bdud rtsi lnga'i chus byugs/ me tog sil ma gtor te/ a bhi dha na las/ bdud rtsi lnga yi/ chu yis ni/ /sa phyogs kyang ni byug par bya/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin me tog /'bad pa yi ni gtor bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sa phyogs der rnal 'byor pa rab yin na/ ro dngos la rigs lnga so so'i mtshan ma/ 'bring na mi lpags la mtshan ma bri/ tha ma yin na dur khrod kyi ro'i ras la mi lpags kyi gzugs bris pa de la rigs lnga'i mtshan ma byas pa'i gdan la kha lho phyogs su phyogs la 'dug ste/ kha lhor lta ba slob dpon dza ya se nas bshad cing / de'i don yang slob dpon bha wa bha dras/ lho shes rab kyi gnas dang / dga' ba'i gnas yin pa'i rgyu mtshan lhor blta bar bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ las dang po pa yin na srod kyi dus su bsgom/ te/ srod dngos grub mang zhing bar chad nyung ba'i dus yin pa'i phyir te/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yul 'di dag ni bu mo gang / /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /rtag tu mtshan mo 'tshams pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'bring yin na/ tho rangs dang thun gnyis su bsgom/ rab yin na nyin gung nam gung dang thun bzhi ru bsgom pa'o/ /bzhi pa ji ltar bsgom pa'i cho ga la bzhi/ lha ma grub pa grub par byed pa'i sgrub thabs/ sngags ma grub pa grub par byed pa'i sgrub thabs/ bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu myur du 'byin pa'i sgrub thabs/ bsgrub pa'i bar chad sel bar byed pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /dang po ni/ grub chen gyi bskyed rim gyi gzhung 'di yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ sa steng na ni rin chen bzhi/ /phreng ba'i sngags ni dam pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rin chen bzhi'i sngags kyi bzlas brjod do/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga ste/ 'di la phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa'i sbyin sreg gsungs la/ gsal byed ni sa skya pa chen po'i nag 'bum du blta'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u sum cu pa nas/ rdza rnga kha bzhi pa la brten nas zhal bzhi pa'i sngags btu lugs gsungs pa'o/ /mdor bstan to/ /rgyas par bshad na/ dang po lha ma grub pa grub par byed pa la yang bzhi ste/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rten bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'o/ /sngon 'gro la gnyis/ thun mong ba'i sngon 'gro dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs gsum gyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gcig tu bsgrub/ tshul khrims rnam dag des gzhi bzung nas/ lam nyams su blangs na dngos grub dogs med du 'grub ste/

slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sdom gsum cho gar mi ldan pa'i/ /sngags pa'i bdag nyid mi 'gyur te/ /sdom gsum cho ga rab tu brtag /ces dang / de ltar sngags pa tshul ldan pas/ /dngos grub la ni dogs med de/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /tshul khrims rnam dag gis gzhi bzung nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang bsgrub pa la tshogs gnyis bsag dgos so/ /de la rten sgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku gsung thugs su song ba zhig dgos la/ bde mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi nga rgyal gyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis bsags pas rang lus bde mchog tu rtogs pa'i rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin 'byung / de la brten nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku gnyis kyi go 'phang thob par byed do/ /de nas lam gyi khog bsgrigs nas sngon 'gro nyams su len pa la thun mong ba 'di gsum pha rgyud ma rgyud kun dang thun mong ba yin pas de skad ces bya la/ de yang skyabs 'gro ni sgrub thabs kyi gzhung na med kyang / a bhi dha na las/ ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /gsum po gang la skyabs su song / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /byang chub mchog ni thob par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed gnyis ka bstan la/ nyams su len tshul ni/ spyir skyabs 'gros sbyang gzhi ma dag pa thams cad sbyong mod/ ngos skal ni rang gi lus sems kyi steng na so thar gyi sdom pa dang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba'i sdig sgrib tshad med pa zhig yod pa de la brten nas/ khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong dgos pa mi gsal ba nus pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa rnams yin la/ de'i steng du tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i 'khor ba rgyu 'bras dang / rgyud gsum gyis bsdus pa'i shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad dril/ de thams cad rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang du bshig nas sbyong byed skyabs 'gro'i rnal 'byor du sgyur bar byed de/

gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ngos skal gyi sbyang gzhi gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang du bshig pa 'di ni ras sam snam bu bkru chags byed pa dang 'dra ste/ sems bskyed dang rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas gnyis la yang shes par bya'o/ /skyabs su 'gro tshul la/ skyabs su 'gro ba po ni rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par gsal ba dang / skyabs su 'gro rogs drin can gyi pha ma dang / mkha' khyab rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal bas skyabs su 'gro ste/ sbyang gzhi srog gcod dang ma byin len la sogs pa'i las rang gi ngo bo thams cad skyabs su 'gro ba po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du bsgyur ba yin gsungs/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'khor lo rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i dbus su bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i gtso bo ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog gtso bo'i sku'i rgyab khaṇḍa ro hi'i mdun du/ de dag gi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan/ rtsa sngags snying po nye snying rnams gsung rab po ti'i rnam par shar ba brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu/ gdong dar dang bcas pa ni chos dkon mchog 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog ste/ sbyang gzhi gang gi srog bcad pa dang / gang la ma byin len sogs byas pa'i yul sems can de rnams sbyong byed gang la skyabs su 'gro yul dkon mchog gsum gyi rnam par bsgyur nas skyabs su 'gro skyabs 'gro'i rgyu kun slong ni 'jigs dad snying rje gsum las/ 'dir tha mal snang zhen gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i phyir du skyabs su 'gro bas/ rang gi gnas khang la sogs pa'i snod thams cad kyang gzhal yas khang du gsal btab nas skyabs 'gro bzhi skor snying thag pa nas/

mgo bcad phung bskyur te re dogs 'gog pa'i tshul du grangs mang na brgya rtsa stong rtsa/ nyung tha'ang nyer gcig byas la thal mo snying khar sbyar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs kyi skyabs gsol lan gsum byas pas/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par zhu nas snying gar thim/ chos po ti rnams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas mgrin par thim/ 'khor gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par zhu nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas sgo gsum rtsa gsum khams gsum rnams dkon mchog gsum dang ro gcig pa'i ngang la cung zhig bzhag sems bskyed ni/ sbyang gzhi byang sems kyi sdom pa dang 'gal ba'i sdig pa mi dge ba rgyu 'bras kyis bsdus pa'i shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad sems bskyedapa po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa dang / de'i dmigs yul du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas dang sems bskyed rnams su bsgyur nas bsgom/ tshig ni bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byas la sems can 'di thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bya'o zhes pa lan gsum mo/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ sbyang gzhi sngags kyi sdom pa dang 'gal ba'i sdig sgrib thams cad rang gi lus sems la bsdus/ de brjod bral du bshig la spyi bo na yod pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzla bya'i sngags rnams su bsgyur ro/ /'di la gsum/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzla ba/ bshags sdom la 'jug pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum ye shes pa'i ngo bor rigs bdag rang chas can skad cig gis gsal btab/ bdud rtsi spyan 'dren pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang / khyad par pho nya gsum gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun rnams spyan drangs pas snying kha'i hūm̐ la bstim/

gzhan spyi dang 'dra/ gnyis pa ni/ dam tshig nyams par gyur pa la/ /sbyor ba 'di ni bsnyen par bya/ /zhi bar gyur nas bla med pa/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dbang yang bskur/ /dus bzhi dag gi rim pa yis/ /phyi dang nang gi chu khrus bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems des smin mtshams yan chad gang / lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang bskur thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying kha yan chad gang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag lus thams cad gang dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag par bsam/ dus bzhi dag gi rim pa yis/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ smin mtshams yan gang ba na dga' ba'i ye shes nyams su myong / mgrin par mchog dga'/ snying gar dga' bral/ lus thams cad la khyab pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong ba'o/ /de lta bu'i bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rnam pa bdud rtsi dkar po'i rnam par gnas pa des/ sbyang gzhi sdig sgrib thams cad bdud rtsi de'i ngang du bsgyur nas sbyang gzhi sbyong byed dbyer med pa'i bde ba chen po'i ngang du bshig nas sngags bzla ba yin no/ /sdig sgrib rnams dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang lam gci lam sogs nas 'thon par bsam pa sogs ni las dang po pa dmigs pa gsal ba'i ched yin gsungs/ phyi dang nang gi chu khrus bya/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ nang gi chu ni bdud rtsi yin la/ 'dis ni dus rgyun gyi yig brgya bzla ba'i tshe nang gi dri ma 'khrud cing dag par bsam/ phyi'i chu ni khrus kyi rnal 'byor spyi dang / sgrub pa po skra bkru ba'i dus kyi chu yin la/ de'i tshe na dbang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis spyan drangs nas dbang bskur zhing sdig sgrib dag par bsam la yig brgya bzla/ grangs ni nyung na'ang nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla dgos te/

slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzla/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa bshags sdom bya ba ni/ spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'/ bla ma dang tha mi dad pa ni rten gyi stobs/ rnam par sun 'byin pa ni/ bdag ni mi shes zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan te/ mi shes pa dang / ma gus pa dang / bag med pa dang / nyon mongs mang ba ste rgyu bzhi'i dbang gis rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig las 'gal/ de'i stobs kyis dngos grub thob pa las nyams shing rtsa ltung byung na ngan song gsum du skyes nas mtho ris kyi bde ba thob pa las nyams na/ byang chub rin po che rnam pa gsum thob pa las nyams pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu la 'gyod pa bsgom pa'o/ /gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs ni/ gtso bo rdo rje zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan te/ da phyin chad gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can khyed la skyabs su song phyin/ khyed kyi gsung bzhin dang du blangs te srog bdos byas nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos par bya snyam pa'o/ /da nyes pa thams cad dag yod snyam pa ni sor chud pa'i stobs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ de'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa dang / rang gi sgo gsum bya byed dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam la mnyam gzhag cung zad skyong ngo / /'di la sems dpa' chen pos/ yid gang du chags pa der skyong zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar thun mong ba gsum song nas thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro dag pa gsum ni/ bdud rtsi ril bu yod na khar bcug yang na bur chang sogs la bdud rtsi btab pa la 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi bdud rtsi byin rlabs byas te/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon skor du bskor cing / dbus nas blangs te lce thog tu bzhag

shrī he ru ka a haṃ zhes brjod cing / shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /zhes sogs yi ge bzhi'i don yang dran par bya zhing brjod do/ /'di'i sbyang gzhi ni rang rgyud kyi sdig sgrib rnams dang / khyad par ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong byed bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsgyur te mgrin pa nas myangs pas/ gzhir gnas kyi khams dang ro gcig tu 'dres te gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bas chos sku rnam thar sgo bzhi'i bdag nyid rgyud la skyes par bsam pa ni ngag dag pa yin no/ /sems dag ni/ mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni a ru shar/ rjes chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du shar/ mnyam rjes gnyis kyi rgyun bskyangs pa las/ ye shes lnga ldan gyi sangs rgyas thob pa ni hūm̐ sngon po'o/ /yang sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba ni hūm̐ du shar/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog sna tshogs pa ni hūm̐ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer sna tshogs par shar ba yin no/ /de skad du/ grub chen dril bu pa'i gzhung las/ snying khar dpal mchog dang po'i ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro bar bsgoms la/ des sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs par bsam zhes gsungs so/ /'di'i sbyang gzhi ni/ gtso bor yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib/ des mtshon pa'i 'khor ba rgyu 'bras/ rgyud gsum gyi bsdus pa'i shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad lus sems gnyis la dril/ de'i nang nas sems la dril/ sems de nyid hūm̐ cha lnga pa ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du bsgom pa yin no/ /sems dag gi hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lus thams cad gang tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du bsgom pa lus dag kyang yin la/ gzhi sbyang bsgyur yang yin no/

/'dis ni sbyang gzhi gtso bor lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib/ des mtshon pa'i 'khor ba rgyu 'bras thams cad lus ngag gi ngo bo 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yab yum du bsgom pa yin no/ /'di'i thad du chos rje blo bzang grags pas rtsod pa dang / de la rje rdo rje 'chang gis lan mdzad pa rnams ni nag po zin bris nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la gnyis te/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang / 'bras bu lha bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang / 'bras bu lha bskyed pa'o/ /grub chen gyi gzhung las/ snying kha'i sa bon 'od tshogs kyis/ /mdun du bde gshegs spyan drangs la/ /mchod pa kun gyis legs mchod rten/ /dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa brjod/ /ces gsungs la/ 'di la gang gis tshogs gsog pa rten gyi gang zag gang la tshogs gsog pa zhing gi rnam gzhag ji ltar gsog pa'i tshul dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ dag pa gsum sngon du song ba'i sgrub pa po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par gsal ba 'di yin no/ /gnyis pa ni spyir bde mchog pa rnams smin mtshams nas 'od zer spro yang / da lan grub chen rang gi gzhung nas gsungs pa ltar/ snying kha nas 'od zer gyi tshogs spros te/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i longs sku'i thugs kha nas sprul pa'i lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de'i steng gi cha la seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs gar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/

lang tsho dar la babs pa/ zhal 'dzum bag can bdag la ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i ngang tshul can zhig bsgom/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yon du bskor ba'i mtha' skor du/ phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs gar 'gying ba/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ klu sgrub rab byung gi cha lugs la sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka dang ldan pa/ pham mthing pa chen po 'jigs med grags pa dang / gcung dus 'khor ba shes rab bzang po gnyis paṇḍi ta'i cha lugs la/ na bza' dkar po bzhes pa/ dbu la paṇa zhwa ring po dang bcas pa/ gzhan bram ze chen po nas/ rje btsun yan gyi bla ma rnams rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs can g.yas ḍa ma ru g.yon thod pa gru mo na kha ṭwaṃ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing ral pa'i cod pan can/ sa paṇa nas bzung mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje btsun sangs rgyas dpal bzang / rje dpal ldan rgyal po/ chos rje bzang po dpal pa/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang / mkhan chen chos dbang phyug gi bar gyi bla ma rnams rab byung gi cha lugs rang rang gi rnam pa dang mthun par bsgom mo/ /gsum pa la gsum/ phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ rgyun bshags bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ngag 'don bzhin dang / dang por bla ma la/ de nas yi dam la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /'di ni sngar yul khyad can rnams la ma dad pa dang / las ngan bsags pa thams cad bla ma dang yi dam la phyag 'tshal ba'i ngo bor bsgyur nas sbyong bar byed do/ /gnyis pa la/ phyi mchod dang / yid byung gi mchod pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ ser snas kun nas bslangs te las ngan ji snyed cig bsags pa dang / dad rdzas gshin zas zos shing 'thungs pa la sogs pa'i ma dag pa'i tshogs thams cad snying ga'i hūm̐ la bsdus/ hūm̐ de las mchod pa'i lha mo lag pa g.yon du thod pa'i nang du mchod yon zhabs bsil la sogs pa'i rang rang gi mchod rdzas thogs pa dpag tu med pa blos khyud tshad sprul nas sngags dang bcas te/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngags ni rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs/ phyag rgya ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas gsungs/ ting nge 'dzin dkon mchog sgron me'i mdo las gsungs te/ ser snas kun nas bslangs te sdig sgrib kyis mtshon/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras thams cad dad rdzas gshin zas la sogs pa'i ma dag pa'i 'tsho ba thams cad snying kha'i hūm̐ la bsdus/ de las sngon byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pa ni/ ba spu'i bu ga re re nas 'od zer gyi tshogs spros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse re re la kun tu bzang po re re/ de re re'i ba spu'i bu ga nas kyang / 'od zer gyi tshogs spros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse re re la yang / rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga/ rig ma bcu drug mchod pa nyi shu ma/ mchod pa nyer lnga ma la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas med na phar zhog yod na yod do cog gis sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa bzhin du/ na mo chos dbyings ma nas bzung / tsa ye swāhā zhes pa'i skabs su/ blos sprul gyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di 'bul zhing / mthar se gol lan gsum gtogs so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa la/ dge ba byas pa mchod par 'bul ba tsam las/ mi dge ba'i las byas pa mchod par bsgyur nas 'bul ba med mod/ gsang sngags thabs la mkhas pas/ mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan yang mchod par bsgyur nas phul bas tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur ba yin no gsungs/ gsum pa rgyun bshags ni/ gur las/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /zhes stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa/ 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /zhes pa rjes su yid rang ba/ sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /zhes pa don dam sems bskyed dam bca'i tshul du yid kyis bzung ba/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/

/byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /zhes pa smon pa sems bskyed/ byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /zhes pa 'jug pa sems bskyed/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa sngar gyi dge ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba'o/ /tshogs zhing byin rlabs bsdu ba'i phyir rang la bstims kyang chog go /gnyis pa ye shes tshogs bsags ni/ gzhung las/ thams cad stong par rnam bsgoms la/ /zhes pas bstan/ nyams su len tshul ni/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad gzung 'dzin gyi sbun lpags dang bral ba'i gnyis med kyi sems rang rig rang gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par gzhag oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ swa bha wa shuddha ni gzung ba thams cad rang bzhin rnam par dag pa/ sarwa dharma swa bha wa shuddho ni 'dzin pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'o/ /gnyis med kyi shes pa rang rig rang gsal de yang mtha' bral stong pa nyid kyi ngang la bshig la/ oṃ shu n+ya tā sogs brjod/ ye shes tshogs bsags rim pa gnyis byung ba ni sbyang gzhi'i dbang gis yin te/ snang ba'i chos thams cad lus la thim pa nas kun gzhi'i gsal cha la thim pa'i bar dang / gsal cha de yang zung 'jug brjod bral la thim pa'i 'chi ba 'od gsal dngos gnyis las/ dang po sbyang ba'i phyir rim pa dang po dang / gnyis pa sbyang ba'i phyir rim pa gnyis pa byung ba yin no/ /de skad du/ mi g.yo ba bla med kyi rgyud las/ dang po mchod pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs khyad par 'phags pa'i las so/ /stong pa nyid kyi mthar thug pa ni 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku dri ma med pa'i lus te/

dri za'i sems so zhes dang / rim bzhi lam slong las/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ba'i lugs kyi 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku zer zhes gsungs shing / chos sku de las gzugs sku 'grub par rtse mos bshad do/ /'chi ba'i tshe snang mched thob gsum lugs 'byung du 'gags pa de nyid bar dor lugs bzlog tu langs te lus grub/ de'i tshe tshad zhag bdun du gnas pa de'i gnas skabs kyi snod bcud thams cad/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo nā da/ de las thig le sogs hūm̐ cha bdun pa 'dis sbyong bar byed do/ /ye shes tshogs bsag gis 'chi srid mi sbyong na hūm̐ cha bdun pa 'dis kyang bar srid mi sbyong bar 'gyur ro/ /yang ljon shing las/ sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pas las nyon sbyong bar gsungs pa ltar na/ ye shes tshogs gsog gis las nyon gyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i bdag 'dzin gtso bor sbyong bar byed pas/ 'chi srid sbyong byed du ma byas kyang chog la/ spyir ni sbyong byed gcig gis sbyang gzhi thams cad sbyong ba dang / sbyang gzhi gcig gi steng du sbyang gzhi thams cad bsdus nas sbyong ba dang / sbyang gzhi re res sbyong byed re re sbyong ba'i tshul dang gsum yod pas/ kun mkhyen rin po che sogs kyi bzhed pa mi 'dra ba de dag kyang lugs tshad ldan re re yin gsungs so/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa la gsum/ dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin/ las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /dang po la gnyis/ rten bskyed pa dang / brten pa bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang / gzhal yas khang bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung las/ sna tshogs pad nyi hūm̐ rdo rje/ /hūm̐ byung khro bo'i tshogs spros nas/ /blo dang ldan pas phur sogs bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ 'di la 'dul byed kyi khro mo spro ba/

gdul bya'i bgegs 'gugs pa/ 'dul tshul phur bu btab pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo brtan po bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bar srid sbyong byed kyi hūm̐ de las paṃ 'phros pa las padma/ raṃ 'phros pa las nyi ma/ hūm̐ gnyis pa 'phros pa las hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i hūm̐ de las sgo mtshams ma brgyad khā gdong ma dang dgu/ khaṇḍa ro hi ste bcu thog mar zhal phyag rnams gsal btab nas/ de nas a bhi dha na las/ mthe bong mdzub mo dang sbyar nas/ se gol gtogs pa phyogs bcur yang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyag rgya dang bstun/ sumbha ni'i sngags brjod pa'i tshe/ phyogs mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis dang bcur/ rdo rje'i rwa ba'i phyir 'ong ba tsam gyi thad du 'phro ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ khwa gdong ma la sogs pa so so'i ba spu'i bu ga re re'i khung bu'i nang nas/ de lta bu ri rab du ma'i mthar thug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor spros te nam mkha'i khams khyab par byas te sngags pas kyang de ltar du bsam par bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros te phyogs skyong bcu'i tshul bzung ba'i bgegs kyi gtso bo dpag tu med pa bkug nas phyogs mtshams steng 'og rnams su 'dul byed kyi khro mo re re'i drung du bgegs re re khugs par bsams pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ hūm̐ de las stod khro bo'i gzugs la smad phur bu zur gsum dbal dang ldan pa me 'bar ba dpag tu med pa spros te/ pho nya rnams kyi lag pa g.yon par gtad/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas btsugs te/ lag pa g.yas kyi rdo rje tho bas brdungs pas pho'i rkang pa g.yas dang mo'i rkang pa g.yon nas phug gser gyi sa gzhi la sbrags pas/ lus 'gul ba med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ yid rnam par rtog pa dang bral bar byas zhes chos rje rdo rje 'chang gsungs pa lū hi pa'i skabs su sgra ji bzhin sbyor/

da lan ro rnams 'od du zhu ba las/ a tsheg drag can du gyur te/ de las srung 'khor bsgom pa yin no/ /bzhi pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo brtan po bsgom pa ni/ 'og gi ro zhu ba las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs kyi ro zhu ba las ra ba/ mtshams kyi rnams las dra ba/ steng gi rnams las gur dang bla bre dang me ri 'bar ba ste/ srung 'khor drug ldan du gsal bar dmigs te sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pa ni bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor gsum bsrung ba'o/ /de gsum ni/ 'phags pa rin po che'i dbang phyug 'bum gyi dris lan las/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor gsum/ /bdag ni sgrub pa po yin te/ /gnas ni gang du bsgrub pa'i yul/ /rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin du brjod/ /ting 'dzin bskyed pa'i gegs bsal phyir/ /rnal 'byor bsrung ba zhes bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mda' dra bsgom pa na mda' rtse rno ba phyir bstan pa/ sngo zing nge spu gri brdar ba lta bu la me 'bar ba dang / me ri bsgom pa na cha sder las rlangs pa 'thon pa bzhin ra gur las me rnams 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros nas phyi rol kun tu 'bar bar bsgom pa 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi phyag len/ mkhan chen nam mkha' sangs rgyas pas rje chos dbang pa la gnang ba yin gsungs/ srung 'khor bsgom pa 'dis ni sbyang gzhi gzhan chos bsgrub pa la bar chad byas pa'i las sgrib tshad med pa bsags nas yod pa/ sems la bag chags dang lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul gyis gnas pa dang / de'i stobs kyis phyi rol gyi snang ba la dmyal ba'i gnas su gshin rje'i pho nya la sogs pa'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / yi dwags dang dud 'gro'i gnas skabs su yang de lta bu'i snang ba 'char/ bar do'i gnas skabs su 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi la sogs pa'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs pa 'char/ da lta mi'i gnas skabs su yang chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad phyi nas bgegs dang log 'dren la sogs pa'i snang ba nang nas 'byung bzhi'i nad la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam pa sems la khams 'dus la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/

mdor na mi 'dod pa rang dbang med par 'byung ba thams cad/ sbyong byed chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis ngo bo bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang / 'dul byed kyi khro mo sngags tho phur dang bcas pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas sbyong bar byed do/ /bsrung rgyu'i bar chad thams cad kyang kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam yin gyis/ don la rang gi sems las gzhan pa'i bar chad med pas/ /rang gi sems thul na bar chad mi 'byung ste/ rgyud las/ rnam par rtog pa bgegs yin te/ /bgegs ni rang gi sems la gnas/ rang gi sems ni thul ba la/ /bgegs kyi 'jug pa ga la yod/ /ces dang / spyod 'jug las/ lcags bsregs sa gzhi su yis byas/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /sems las gzhan pa'i bar chad med kyang kun rdzob tu thabs srung 'khor bsgoms pas bsrung nus pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sngon rgya gar phyogs su mu stegs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig dang / sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa bho dza bde ba'i gtam rgyud bzhin no/ /gnyis pa gzhal yas khang la gnyis te/ gzhal yas khang gtso bor bsgom pa dang zhar byung dur khrod bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ blo dang ldan pas mkha' dbyings su/ /'byung ba thams cad 'dus pa las/ /ji bzhin sna tshogs bzhir gyur pa'i/ /'byung ba bzhi ni rnam par bsgom/ /de yi rim pa 'di yin te/ /ba glang lhas kyi mi 'ching dang / /lhag ma skem byed rtsa gnas so/ /brag chen po yi ngo bor yang / /mi byed rus sbal dag gyur pa/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don mkha' dbyings te chos 'byung gi nang du 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa bsgom pa 'di yin la/ 'di la mngal gyi sngon 'gro sbyang ba'i phyir lugs bzlog dang / dngos gzhi sbyong ba'i phyir lugs 'byung du bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bar srid mngal du ma zhugs bar der bar srid 'khor ba tsam gyi skabs la mngal gyi sngon 'gro zhes bya zhing /

de'i tshe na pha'i rdo rje dang ma'i padma 'phrad pa'i gnas skabs su sa/ gsher ba byang sems 'byung ba ni chu/ 'dod chags kyi drod 'byung ba ni me/ rtsa gnas su 'phul bar byed pa ni rlung ste bzhi po 'di sbyong ba la/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po sogs 'byung ba rang rang gi sa bon las kha dog dbyibs mtshan ma dang ldan pa bsgom pa ngag 'don bzhin yin la/ khams dkar dmar 'dres pa las bde ba nyams su myong ba ni/ suṃ las ri rab thig le ser po dang bcas pas sbyong bar byed do/ /gnyis pa lugs 'byung bsgom pa ni/ bar srid mngal du zhugs pa ni mngal gyi dngos gzhi yin la/ de'i tshe na bar do'i rnam shes rlung gi zhon pa can yin pas thog mar rlung / 'dod chags kyi mes drod dang bcas pa ni me/ gsher ba byang sems dang 'phrad pa'i tshe na chu/ khams dkar dmar dang bar do gcig tu 'dres pa'i gong bu ni sa ste lugs 'byung bzhi po 'di sbyong ba'i phyir du bar snang gi hūm̐ cha bdun pa las hūm̐ gnyis pa chad nas 'byung ba lugs bzlog ri rab dang bcas pa la 'dres pa'i rkyen byas nas de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa las 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam ljang khu sogs 'byung ba lugs 'byung du bsgoms pas sbyong bar byed/ lus chags pa'i gnas skabs kyi nar nar po ltar ltar po/ khrang khrang po la sogs pa'i skabs rnams ni/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can gyis sbyong bar byed/ de nas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dang rnam shes tshogs brgyad la sogs pa'i rtog pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams ni rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa 'dis sbyong bar byed do/ /de yang sngar gyi chos 'byung gru gsum ni chos sku yon tan rnam thar sgo gsum dang / phyi dkar la nang dmar ba ni thabs shes gnyis kyi ngo bo yin pas sbyang gzhi'i dbang du byas na/

mngal skyes kyi mngal/ sgong skyes kyi sgo nga / drod gsher skyes kyi gang du skye ba'i sa phyogs/ brdzus skyes kyi gang du skye ba'i nam mkha' me tog 'bras bu la sogs pa rnams/ sbyong byed chos 'byung gi rnam pa can du bsgyur nas bsgoms pas rnam pa lam byed/ de nyid rnam thar sgo gsum sogs su bsgoms pas mos pa lam byed/ 'bras dus kyi chos sku'i yon tan sogs dngos yin pa bsgoms pas 'bras bu lam byed/ de ltar bsgoms pas sgrub pa po'i rgyud byin gyis rlob pa ni byin rlabs lam byed de/ zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel pas mi bslu bas zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /de bzhin du 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa bsgom pa na yang / rang rang gi sbyang gzhi mngal gyi gnas skabs kyi 'byung bzhi lus grub tshul dang bcas pa de nyid sbyong byed rnal 'byor ba rang gi blos snang la bsgoms pas 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ri rab dang bcas pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas bsgoms pas rnam pa lam byed/ de dag kyang lha mo spyan ma la sogs pa'am/ mkha' 'gro ma dang / lā ma dang / khaṇḍa ro hi dang / phag mo dang lnga'i ngo bor mos pa ni mos pa lam byed/ rtsa rgyud las/ sa ni spyan zhes bya bar bshad/ /chu yi khams ni ma ma kī /me ni gos dkar mo ru brjod/ /rlung ni sgrol mar grags pa ste/ /tsum bha na ni stong pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /lha mo bzhi yang tshad med bzhi'i rang bzhin yin pas 'bras bu lam byed/ de ltar bsgoms pas byin gyis rlob pa ni byin rlabs lam byed yin no/ /de ltar 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang bsgom tshul la/ grub chen rang gi dkyil chog las/ de ltar sna tshogs bris pa yi/ /gzhal med khang mchog lha yi gnas/ /zhes dang / iṇḍa nī la'i sa gzhi la/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid bsam/ /zhes pa tsam las gsal bar gsungs pa med pas/ rtsa rgyud dang a bhi dha na gnyis rtsa bshad du sbyar nas 'chad par byed pa ste/

de yang rtsa rgyud las/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung grong khyer mchog /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa thig gdab bya/ /khru gang khru bzhi khru brgyad pa/ /sgo bzhi kun nas zur bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /sngags pas gnyis 'gyur rnam dpyad cing / /de yi dbus su padma ni/ /'dab bcas lte ba 'bar dang bcas/ /ge sar yang dag ldan par bzhag /ces dang / a bhi dha na'i le'u bcu gnyis pa las/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi'i dbus dag tu/ /'khor lo nyi shu bzhi brtsegs mchog /de yi dbus su padma ni/ /sna tshogs 'dab mas nye bar mdzes/ /'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar bcas/ /ge sar gyis ni nye bar mdzes/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /dra ba dra phyed rnams kyis brgyan/ /mtshan nyid thams cad ldan pa'o/ /zhes dang / 'khor lo padma rdo rje'i phreng / /'khor lo gsum po yongs su bskor/ /ji ltar dam tshig mchog 'khor lo/ /sna tshogs rdo rje phreng gis bskor/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis gzhal yas khang gi mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs bstan pas/ 'di 'chad pa la/ phyi'i gnas lugs dang nang gi gnas lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ kye rdor sogs spyi dang mthun pas/ gnad kyi zla zer las 'byung ba bzhin/ /kun mkhyen rin po che bsod nams seng ges tshigs bcad dubasdebs pa las/ 'og gzhi sogs dang steng thog dang / /sgo dang rta babs lnga yis bsdus/ /'og la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /nyi ma padma khor yug go /rdo rje'i lte ba gru bzhi'i rgyar/ /cha chen bcu gnyis dpangs su gcig /ra rtse yan lag bzhi drug la/ /gsum dang lnga ste cha chen gnyis/ /de 'og nyi ma pad lte yin/ /rdo rje lte ba'i zur dang mnyam/ /pad 'dab cha phran gnyis pas bskor/ /yan lag bzhi phyogs padma med/ /'khor yug dur khrod chos 'byung dang / /gur dang rdo rwa me ris te/ /srung 'khor thun mong min bsgoms na/ /gur nang de dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes pas 'og gzhi bshad la/

de yang 'og gi sna tshogs rdo rje rwa rtse nas rwa rtse'i bar la cha phran drug cu rtsa bzhi ste/ sdom 'byung las/ mtshan ma drug cu rtsa bzhi yi/ /thig le khams rnams nges par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ rdo rje de'i lte ba gru bzhi rgyar cha chen bcu gnyis/ dpangs su cha chen gcig yod pa yin no/ /logs la rtsig pa pha gu dang / /dra phyed pa dang gdung leb ste/ /rtsig pa dbus nas cha chen bzhi/ /dor nas lnga pa'i dang po la/ /kha dog lnga sbrags cha phran gcig /dpangs su cha phran bcu drug go /de steng pha gu cha phran gcig /zheng du phyed dang gnyis yin te/ /ba gam tshul du rtsig pa las/ /phyi ru cha phran phyed 'phags so/ /de steng dra phyed sa la ni/ /dpangs su cha phran phyed pa yin/ /shing brtsegs 'og ma cha phran gcig /gong ma phyed phyed kyis lhag pa'i/ /bzhi brtsegs phyogs bzhir brgyad brgyad dang / /zur bzhir bzhi steng sum cu drug /de steng gdung leb cha phran gcig /dpangs su cha phran lnga chas 'gebs/ /phyi ngos shing brtsegs dag gi thad/ /chu srin mgo'am gzi pa tra'i/ /kha nas g.yas g.yon do shal gyi/ /rtsa ba gnyis dang phyed pa yi/ /rtsa ba nas bzung pha gu la/ /'phyang ba'i tshul du gnas pa'o/ /rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi/ /stegs bu dmar po cha phran gnyis/ /phyogs bzhir lha mo bzhi bzhi yis/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i gnas/ /zhes dang / thog phub 'og ma nang ngos zlum/ /phyi ru gru bzhi gdung leb las/ /phyi ru bya 'dab cha phran gnyis/ /de la 'og tu mda' yab dang / /pu shu cha phran re re ste/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs kyis brgyan/ /ces pa ltar shes par bya zhing / 'di'i dpangs la rtsig pa cha phran bcu drug gi steng du/ pha gu cha phran gcig shing brtsegs cha phran gcig gdung leb cha phran gcig ste bcu dgu yod pa ni dam tshig 'khor lo'i thog phub man gyi dpangs su rtsi ba yin no/ /gnyis pa nang gi gnas lugs ni/

rje btsun gyi don 'grel chen mo las/ gzhal yas khang de'i dbus su 'khor lo rim pa bzhi mchod rten zlum po'i tshul du je mtho la song ba yin la/ 'khor lo rnams kyi rtsibs kyi ngo bo ni dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi las cung zad gyen la 'phags pa tsam/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi ngo bo ni lha rang rang gi pus mo'i tshad tsam/ ra ba rnams ni lha rang rang gi sked par sleb pa tsam yin la/ ka ba rnams ni lha rang rang gi dbu'i steng nas khru gang tsam gyis ma reg pa/ steng gi phub kyi 'og gi phub non cing / blos snang la char gyi chu lta bu yang gcig gis chu gcig gis steng du babs nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu'i phyi sor 'bab pa/ dam tshig 'khor lo ni dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la phebs pa'o zhes gsungs la/ de'i don la chos rje rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa sde snod 'dzin pa bsam 'grub bzang pos lugs bskyar ba gcig dang / nyag re yon tan 'od zer ba la sogs pa'i lugs gcig dang gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ rtsig pa'i nang nas lha snam phyogs mdog can la cha chen re yod pa dor ba'i dbus cha chen drug gi rgya ni/ gzhal yas khang gi gar bu gru bzhi pa ind+ra nī la'i sa gzhir grags pa de'i rgya yin zhing / 'di'i dpangs su cha phran dgu 'og gi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la reg par gnas so/ /gar bu de'i dbus su sku 'khor gyi lte ba'i dpangs la cha phran gnyis/ rgyar cha phran bcu dgu/ sku 'khor gyi lte ba'i sked pa nas thon pa'i rtsibs cha phran phyed dang gsum pa dpangs su cha phran gcig pa/ rtsibs kyi mtha' 'og gzhi gar bu'i rgya dang mnyam pas/ rtsibs mtha' tshun la cha phran nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'khor lo'i re ba dkar pos 'khor mor bskor ba/ rtsibs mtshams brgyad du 'khor los mtshan pa'i ka gdan rin po che chu shel las grub pa cha phran gnyis pa re/ de'i steng du ka ba cha phran lnga pa/ de'i steng gzhu thung gzhu ring la cha phran re re/

gdung zlum la cha phran gyi lnga cha/ de dang phyi'i gser gyi gdung leb kyi bar la rin po che'i lcam dang gral ma/ rin po che sna lnga'i 'jim pa la sogs pas thog phub pa'i 'og tu lha snam phyogs mdog can la sgo mtshams ma brgyad bzhugs pa ni dam tshig 'khor lo'i thog phub ste thog phub rim pa dang po'o/ /thob phub 'di man gyi phyi nang gnyis ka'i dpangs la cha phran bcu dgu brtsi ba ni blos dpyad nas shes par bya ste/ phyi'i gser gyi gdung leb man la cha phran bcu dgu yod pa sngar bshad zin ma thag pa ltar yin zhing / nang ngos la gar bu cha phran dgu pa'i steng du sku 'khor gyi ka gdan cha phran gnyis/ ka ba cha phran lnga/ gzhu ring thung la cha phran gnyis/ gdung zlum la gcig ste cha phran bcu dgur 'gyur ba yin no/ /yang sku 'khor gyi lte ba'i dkyil 'khor drang thad nas gsung 'khor gyi lte ba 'bur te dpangs cha phran gnyis/ rgyar cha phran bcu bzhi/ rtsibs rnams sngar dang 'dra/ padma'i ra ba cha phran gnyis pas 'khor yug tu bskor ba/ sku 'khor gyi lte ba'i steng du ka gdan padma rā ga las grub pa dpangs cha phran gnyis/ de'i steng ka ba cha phran lnga pa/ gzhu ring thung la cha phran re re/ gdung zlum la gcig gdung khebs la cha phran gcig gi lnga cha/ de la nang logs sam nang gi rgya byas la/ phyi'i rgya sku 'khor gyi gdung zlum gyi steng du chu shel las grub pa'i rtsig zlum cha phran gcig pha gur dra ba dra phyed gdung leb dang bcas pa la cha phran gcig yod pa de dang sngar gyi de'i bar la thog phub pa'i nang du sku 'khor ba rnams bzhugs so/ /thog phub rim pa gnyis pa'o/ /yang gsung 'khor gyi lte ba nas thugs 'khor gyi lte ba 'bur te/ rgyar cha phran dgu/ dpangs dang rtsig pa sngar dang 'dra/ rdo rje'i rwa bas bskor bas rtsibs mtshams rnams su ka gdan dpangs cha phran gnyis pa gsung 'khor gyi lte ba nas btsugs pa/ de'i steng du ka ba nas gdung leb kyi bar sngar dang 'dra bas nang gi rgya byas la/

phyir rgya gsung 'khor gyi gdung zlum gyi steng du/ rtsig pa pha gu dra ba dra phyed gdung leb dang bcas pa la cha phran gnyis yod pa de dang sngar gyi de'i bar la thog phub pa'i nang du gsung 'khor ba rnams bzhugs so/ /thog phub rim pa gsum pa'o/ /thugs 'khor gyi lte ba drang thad nas bde chen 'khor lo'i lte ba 'bur te thugs 'khor gyi lte ba'i steng du ka gdan cha phran gnyis pa bde chen rang gi lte ba'i dpangs dang mnyam pa/ steng padma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa gri gug gi ra bas bskor ba/ ka gdan gyi steng du ka ba cha phran lnga pa nas gdung zlum gyi bar sngar gyi de dang 'dra bas nang gi rgya byas la/ phyir rgya thugs 'khor gyi gdung zlum gyi steng du rtsig pa cha phran gcig pha gu dra ba dra phyed gdung leb dang bcas pa la cha phran gcig yod pa de dang / sngar gyi de'i bar la thog phub pa'i nang du thugs 'khor ba rnams bzhugs so/ /thog phub rim pa bzhi pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i ka bas btegs pa'i gdung zlum gyi steng du rtsig zlum cha phran gcig de'i steng pha gu dang dra ba dra phyed gdung leb dang bcas pa la cha phran gcig de'i steng du cha phran gcig gi dpangs dang mnyam pa'i thal gdung gru bzhi pa shar nub dang lho byang la btang ba'i re mig brgyad phub/ gdung zur la bslangs pa'i bar stong nag sang nge ba rnams rin po che'i yas bad mas bad kyis bkag cing / thog phub 'di'i 'og na snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi bum thod bzhi dang bcas pa yod do/ /thog phub rim pa lnga pa'o/ /re mig gru bzhi pa der rtsig pa sngon po gru bzhi pa dpangs cha phran gnyis/ de'i steng du pha gu cha phran phyed/ dra ba dang dra phyed gdung khebs dang bcas pa la cha phran phyed dang gnyis te bde chen gyi lte ba yan nas 'di'i bar la dpangs cha phran bcu bdun brtsi zhing / de'i steng du gar bu'i dpangs cha phran dgu/ sku gsung thugs kyi lte ba'i dpangs cha phran gnyis gnyis yod pas drug ste bco lnga po de bsnan pas sum cu so gnyis 'byung ba ni/

dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi rgya dang dpangs gnyis mnyam pa ste lus kyi dag pa dang 'grigs pa yin no gsungs so/ /de ltar dpangs cha phran so gnyis song ba de'i steng du rin po che'i thog rgya phibs ltar phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis mtshan pa'i steng du nor bu rin po che 'od zer 'bar bas bskor ba/ dbus rwa sbubs can la btsugs nas yod pa/ 'di'i 'og na gtso bo yab yum bzhugs te/ thog phub rim pa drug pa'o/ /thog phub kun la bya 'dab dang / mda' yab dang pu shu rnams kyang ji ltar 'tshams par bya zhing gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras par bya'o/ /lugs gnyis pa ni/ lha snam phyogs mdog can la dpangs cha phran gcig gar bu la cha phran phyed dang dgu /de'i steng du sku 'khor gyi dpangs la cha phran gnyis yod pa'i yas mas su cha phran phyed re bzhag pa'i bar cha phran gcig la rtsibs cha phran gcig pa 'thon pa'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du ra ba cha phran gnyis pas bskor/ rwa ba'i steng du ka ba cha phran lnga pa/ gzhu ring thung la gcig gdung zlum la gcig go /ka ba 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du btsugs pa'i stobs kyis rtsibs kyis mi thegs pa'i blos snang byung na/ rtsibs 'og tu sa stegs gru bzhi pa cha phran phyed pa re bzhag go /gsung 'khor thugs 'khor gnyis la yang de'i rigs bsgres shing / bde chen gyi padma'i yu ba la cha phran gnyis/ padma la gcig ka ba la lnga/ gzhu ring thung la gcig gdung zlum la gcig de'i steng gi rtsig pa la gnyis/ thal gdung la gcig tu lnga chas ma tshang ba'o/ /de yan gyi dpangs la cha phran bzhi pa kun dang mthun pas/ de ltar byas na phyi rtsig pa nas yar brtsis kyang cha phran so gnyis/ nang gar bu nas yar brtsis kyang cha phran so gnyis so/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i dgongs pa yang phal cher 'di dang mthun te/ sdom tshig bcad ma las/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i pho brang la/

/gser gyi gdung leb man chad kyi/ /rgya dpangs sgo dang rta babs dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi dang mthun/ /rtsig nang lha snam cha chen re/ /ngor nas dbus kyi cha drug la/ /ind+ra ni la'i sa gzhi yi/ /dpangs su cha phran phyed dang dgu/ /de steng sku 'khor lte ba'i dpangs/ /cha phran gnyis kyi sked pa nas/ /rtsibs kyi dpangs la cha phran gcig /rtsibs mtha' 'og gzhi'i logs dang mnyam/ /rtsibs kyi mtshams su 'khor lo yi/ /ra ba cha phran gnyis pa'i steng / /'khor lo'i ka ba cha phran lnga/ /ka gzhu shing brtsegs gdung zlum rnams/ /cha phran gnyis dang lnga cha gcig /de dang phyi yi gdung leb gnyis/ /mnyam pa'i steng du thog phub ste/ /dam tshig 'khor lo'i thog phub yin/ /gdung zlum steng du rtsig pa dang / /pha gu gnyis la cha phran gcig /dra phyed pa dang gdung leb la/ /cha phran gcig ste ra ba nas/ /bzung ste gdung leb zlum po'i bar/ /sku yi 'khor lo'i logs yin te/ /gsung 'khor rtsibs kyi rtse mor ni/ /ra ba nas bzung gdung zlum bar/ /snga ma'i tshad bzhin gnas pa dang / /mnyam pa'i steng du thog phub ste/ /'di ni sku 'khor thog yin phyir/ /'khor lo nyid kyis mtshan pa'o/ /de yi rigs pas gsung 'khor te/ /khyad par padmas mtshan pa'o/ /de yi rigs pas thugs 'khor te/ /khyad par rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /de yi rigs pas bde chen gyi/ /'khor lo yin te khyad par ni/ /gru gug gis mtshan 'khor lo yi/ /tshab tu padma 'dab brgyad do/ /rtsibs dang pad 'dab rnams kyi rgyar/ /cha phran gnyis par mnyam pa ste/ /lte ba rim bzhin de'i tshad kyi/ /chung ba yin te rtsibs kyi rtse/ /'og ma'i lte ba dang mnyam phyir/ /'og ma'i lte bar gong ma yis/ /ka gdan cha phran phyed dang gnyis/ /rtsibs kyi bar mtshams brgyad du bya/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i gdung zlum steng / /rtsig pa nas bzung gdung leb bar/ /cha phran gnyis te de steng du/ /thal gdung bzhi la cha phran gcig

/phyur bu'i tshad la cha chen gcig /spyi dang mthun te 'og gzhi nas/ /phyur ba'i thog 'og bar dag dang / /rtsig nang rgya dang mnyam pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /thog phub 'og ma'i gzhal yas khang gi rtsig ngos kyi phyogs bzhir/ sgo/ sgo khyud/ sgo 'gram la sogs pa dang steng du rta babs bzhi'i rnam gzhag rnams ni/ sgo ni phyogs bzhi'i rtsig pa'i dbus/ /cha chen gcig ste dpangs su gnyis/ /de yi g.yas g.yon sgo 'gram la/ /cha phran gnyis te slar yang mdun/ /sgo logs nang du cha phran gnyis/ /phyi ru cha phran bzhi yin te/ /rtsig gdong ser kha yod phyir ro/ /yas phub rtsig pa cha phran gcig /thams cad dpangs su cha phran dgu /de steng thog rnams mnyam par phub/ /sgo khyud phyi mthar sgo glegs gzhug /rta babs ka ba sgo logs kyi/ /g.yas g.yon cha phran re dor nas/ /ka ba cha phran lnga pa re/ /phyi ma'i phyi mtha' stegs bu mnyam/ /nang ma'i nang ngos 'dod snam reg /de steng snam bu 'og ma ni/ /g.yas g.yon cha phran gsum gsum ste/ /gnyis pa gnyis dang gsum pa gcig /bzhi pa sgo logs rtsig gdong mnyam/ /g.yas g.yon skas kyi rim pa bzhin/ /mdun ngos thams cad mnyam po la/ /kha dog dbye bas so sor phye/ /g.yas g.yon cha phran gsum gsum ste/ /gnyis pa gnyis dang gsum pa gcig /bzhi pa sgo logs rtsig gdong mnyam/ /g.yas g.yon skas kyi rim pa bzhin/ /mdun ngos thams cad mnyam po la/ /kha dog dbye bas so sor phye/ /de steng padma chos 'khor gdugs/ /pha phran gcig dang gnyis dang gcig /g.yas g.yon ri dwags pho mo gnyis/ /shin tu sbyar min rgyang ring min/ /rta babs snam bu do shal ni/ /pu shu'i khor ra khor yug tu/ /gos 'phan me tog 'phreng ba sogs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis mdzes par brgyan/ /nang ngos rgya dpangs mnyam pa ni/ /lus kyi dag pa nyid dang sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /'dir rje rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa rta babs sgo gdong la bkri bar bzhed/

kun mkhyen rin po ches rta babs kyi khang gi steng 'gebs par bzhed do/ /rje btsun gyis don 'grel chen mo las/ sgo khang gi steng 'gebs pa ni rta babs yin pas ka ba bzhis mtho bar btegs la/ rtsig pa'i dngos gzhi dang rta babs kyi bar na nam mkha' stong pa dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di 'dren par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe na sgo logs kyi phyi mtha' cha phran re re song ba'i sar stegs bu gru bzhi pa dpangs su cha phran gcig de'i steng du bum pa cha phran gcig pa bzhi/ de'i steng du ka ba cha phran lnga pa bzhi 'dzugs te/ slob dpon klu'i blos/ bum pa ka ba'i steng gnas pa'i/ /sgo las sum 'gyur rta babs te/ /zhes dang / stegs bu bum pa la gnas pa'i/ /rta babs ka ba drang por byed/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gzhal yas khang 'di'i sbyang gzhi ni/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang / nang bsgrub pa pos rang gi lus dbang rten khog pa dang bcas pa 'di nyid yin la/ sbyong byed sangs rgyas kyi thugs byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo gzhal yas khang gi rnam par shar ba 'di nyid du bsgyur nas sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras sku gsum gyi nang nas thugs rnam par mi rtog pa chos kyi sku dang / rigs lnga'i nang nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /zhar byung dur khrod ni/ a bhi dha na las/ phyi rol dur khrod ma rungs pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs can mchog dam pa/ /sna tshogs shing rnams dga' ba dang / khyi dang lce spyang ma rungs pa/ /zhes pas bstan/ 'di la bsgom tshul ni/ srung 'khor gyi phyi ru bsgoms kyang chog nang du bsgoms kyang chog da lta phyag len la nang du bsgom zhing / dur khrod kyis 'khor ba'i chos mtshon/ /gzhal yas khang gis lam gyi chos mtshon/ nang gi lha rnams kyis 'bras bu'i chos mtshon zhing de gsum yang don de na la dbyer med yin no/ /dur khrod ni sngon byung gi dbang du byas na/

bskal pa rtsod dus kyi mgo brtsams pa'i tshe na skye dgu rnams 'thab rtsod byas pas/ gcig gis gcig bsad pa'i ro rnams phyogs mtshams brgyad du bskyal bas/ bya khyi ce spyang rnams kyis ro'i kha phye bas rlangs pa rnams nam mkhar song ste char babs pas chu brgyad byung / chus brlan pas shing brgyad byung / shing gi rtsa ba la brten pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad byung / yal ga la brten pa'i zhing skyong brgyad byung / chu'i rlangs pa nam mkhar song bas sprin brgyad dang / de la gnas pa'i klu brgyad byung / der 'dre dang srin po dang ro langs la sogs pa du ma 'dus te gnas de gnyan por song bas rim gnyis la brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams/ spyod la byon pas grub thob brgyad byung / rus pa 'thor ba rnams bsdus te tsha tshar btab/ de bzhugs pa'i gnas brtsigs pas mchod rten brgyad byung bar slob dpon bsod snyoms pas dur khrod kyi rtogs pa dang / rje btsun rin po ches he ru ka'i byon tshul las gsungs so/ /'di'i sbyang gzhi ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rtog pa rnams yin la/ sbyong byed rnam thar brgyad kyi rang bzhin dur khrod du bsgyur nas sbyangs pas 'bras bu rnam thar brgyad thob par byed do/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ 'dir bsgom bya lha'i dkyil 'khor gang bsgom snyam na/ 'di la rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor dang / rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis las/ dang po la lha lnga ma gcig dgu ma bzhi/ bcu gsum ma gcig nyer gcig ma gsum ste dgu yod pa las/ lha lnga ma ni gtso bo la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis bskor ba'o/ /dgu ma bzhi ni/ gtso bo la thugs 'khor brgyad kyis bskor ba dang / gsung 'khor brgyad kyis bskor ba dang / sku 'khor brgyad kyis bskor ba dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bskor ba rnams so/ /bcu gsum pa ni/
