gtso bo la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bskor ba'o/ /nyer gcig ma gsum ni/ bcu gsum ma de la thugs 'khor brgyad bsnan pa dang / gsung 'khor brgyad bsnan pa dang / sku 'khor brgyad bsnan pa rnams so/ /rigs rkyang dgu po de'i gzhal yas khang ni rigs bsdus dang mi 'dra ste/ thog phub rim pa gsum dang nang ka ba brgyad dang bcas pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad sogs kyi gdan bkod nas lha bskyed pa yin no/ /rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pas/ rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor 'di dag kyang gang 'thad bsgoms pas chog gsungs/ de ltar rigs rkyang rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor bcu las/ 'dir rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom la /de'i gtso bo la rgyu 'bras gnyis las/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa yin la/ mngon byang dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ ri steng sna tshogs padma yi/ /lte bar a l̥ ka l̥ skyes/ /zhes pas bstan/ mngon byung gsum pa ni sbyin sreg gi gzhung las bstan/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las kyang mngon byang gsal bar gsungs la/ bskyed tshul ni/ bde chen 'khor lo'i padma'i lte bar nyi ma dang 'jigs byed pho mo'i gdan gyi steng du a l̥ bcu drug phrag gnyis g.yas bskor dang / g.yon bskor mgo gnyis dang mjug gnyis phan tshun rtse sprad de bsgom/ de yang sbyang gzhi sgrub pa po'i rkang pa g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong nas spyi gtsug gi bar la a l̥ bcu drug bcu drug gi rnam pa can gyi khams gnas pa rnams sbyang ba dang / lam gyi gnas skabs su thabs shes zung 'jug gi nyams len mtshon pa dang / 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi mtshan bzang po so gnyis mtshon par bya ba'i phyir ā l̥ phrag gnyis bsgom ste/ sbyang gzhi khams bcu drug tshan pa gnyis sbyong byed ā l̥ phrag gnyis kyi rnam par bsgyur ba ni rnam pa lam byed/

phrag gnyis kyang mtshan bzang po so gnyis su mos pa ni mos pa lam byed/ sangs rgyas la mnga' ba'i mtshan bzang po so gnyis dngos yin par bsgom pa ni 'bras bu lam byed/ des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa sbyong ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba ni byin rlabs lam byed/ 'bras bu dngos su zhen nas lam la 'jug pa ni zhen pas 'jug pa/ de ltar bsgoms pa la brten nas 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur ba ni 'brel pas mi bslu ba'o/ /de lta bu'i ā l̥ phrag gnyis rgyur byas te zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo skya chil pa zhig bsgom/ 'di ni pha'i khams dkar po zhu nas ma'i skye gnas su hril 'dril ba'i gnas skabs de sbyong byed yin te/ mngal skyes kyi lus 'grub pa'i rgyu gtso bo pha ma'i khu khrag gnyis las/ mngon byang dang po'i skabs 'dir pha'i khu ba dang / des mtshon sgrub pa po'i lus 'di la zag bcas kyi lus bskyed pa'i khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa thams cad sbyong byed zla ba'i rnam par bsgyur nas me long lta bu'i ye shes su mos pa sogs kyi lam byed bzhi'am drug ldan du bsgom mo/ /zla ba'i steng du mngon byung gnyis pa'i rgyu dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo kā l̥ bzhi bcu phrag gnyis bsgom/ 'di ni sbyang gzhi ma'i rakta rtsa'i sgo nas 'byung ba'i rgyu 'byung ba bzhi dang / nam mkha'i khams dang lnga yod pa'i 'byung ba la 'byung chung bcu drug dang / nam mkha' la bde ba nam mkha' nyid kyi khams zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dga' ba bzhir dbye bas nyi shu/ de re re la khu rdul dang khrag rdul gnyis gnyis su dbye bas bzhi bcu/ bzhi bcu po de la thabs shes gnyis gnyis su dbye bas brgyad cu 'byung ba ni sbyong byed/ kā l̥ phrag gnyis kyi rnam par bsgyur nas dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur mos pa sogs lam byed bzhi ldan sngar dang 'dra/

kā l̥ de zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo dmar chil ba zhig bsgom/ 'di ni ma'i rakta skye gnas su dmar hril 'dril ba de sbyong byed nyi ma'i rnam par bsgyur nas mnyam nyid ye shes su mos pa sogs kyi lam byed bzhi ldan sogs sngar dang 'dra'o/ /nyi zla gnyis kyi bar du mngon byang gsum pa sa bon las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa ni sbyang bzhi khu khrag gi bar du bar srid zhugs pa de/ sbyong byed phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan par bsgyur nas sor rtog ye shes su mos pa sogs kyi lam byed bzhi ldan bya/ mngon byung bzhi pa ni de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i 'od kyi gong bu ste/ sbyang gzhi khu khrag dang bar srid ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i gong bu de/ sbyong byed mngon byang dang po gsum ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i 'od kyi gong bur bsgyur nas bya grub ye shes su mos pa sogs kyi lam byed bzhi ldan bya/ mngon byang lnga pa ni de las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par bzhengs pa ste/ sbyang gzhi skye gnas nas phyir btsas te lus grub pa'i gnas skabs de sbyong byed lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i rnam pa sogs su bsgyur nas chos dbyings ye shes su mos pa sogs kyi lam byed bzhi ldan pa'o/ /lha de'i zhal bzhi ni/ rtsa zhal dkar po/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ rgyab ser ba/ g.yas sngo ba yin la/ phyag mtshan ni/ rgyud las/ dus min 'chi las rnam rgyal zhing / yan lag kha ṭwaṃ ga dang sbyar/ /thod pa mchod yon snod du ni/ /zhal du mtshon cha nges par sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dpe mthong ba tsam gyis rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i phyir dkrugs nas bzhag la/ de bla ma'i man ngag gis bkrol zhing / phyag mtshan rim bzhin 'dzin tshul bshad na/ dus min ni gshin rje'i lag tu zhags pa 'dzin pas g.yon gyi bzhi pa'i zhags pa bstan/

'chi ba ni mdung rtse gsum pa/ rnam rgyal ni ma rig pa'i gnyid las rgyal ba'i ḍa ma ru/ yan lag ni glang lpags/ kha ṭwaṃ ga ni kha ṭwaṃ ga thod pa ni thod pa gcod pa'i dgra satwa/ mchod yon snod ni thod pa/ zhal ni tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa/ mtshon cha ni gru gug de rnams 'dzin pa'i go rim ni/ nag po sgrub thabs kyi mchod brjod du/ yi dwags gdan la bzhugs shing zhal rnams kun la spyan gsum dang ni phag mo dmar lus la/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis 'khyud gzhan gnyis kyis ni myur du glang chen lpags pa brgyangs/ /lhag ma g.yon pa phyag bzhi yis ni kha ṭwaṃ zhags pa mi thod tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'chang / /g.yas pa gri gug rtse gsum dgra satwa rnga chung 'chang ba'i he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de yang g.yon gyi bzhi ni/ mdun nas rgyab tu bgrang ba dang / g.yas kyi bzhi rgyab nas tshur mdun la bgrang ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /sngar gyi de tshe sgrub la spyi bo'i mtho gang tsam gyi nam mkhar kha ṭwaṃ ga dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa'i rtse mor hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs kha ṭwāṃ ga la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa spyi bo nas zhugs te/ lus thams cad gang ba ni/ dus min 'chi las rnam rgyal zhing / /zhes pa'i don no/ /de yan gyis brten pa lha bskyed pa la gnyis yod pa'i dang po mngon byang lnga las rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa song zin nas/ da ni gnyis pa zhu ba glus bskul ba las 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bzhengs pa la gnyis te/ zhu ba glus bskul ba dang / 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bzhengs pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ sbyor ba 'du shes sum ldan bya ba/ de las thig ler zhu ba/ de las glus bskul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar lus lha'i 'du shes/

yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs te zhes sogs mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa ngag sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te 'du shes sum ldan no /gnyis pa ni/ 'du shes sum ldan gyi sgo nas snyoms par bzhugs pas bde ba chen po'i sgra hūm̐ dang aṃ gi sgra grags pa dang / snying ga'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / steng gi nam mkhar yod pa'i bar srid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ cha bdun pa rnams bkug nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying kha'i bar du byon/ de'i tshe na de dag dang / rang rgyud la yod pa'i skye gnas bzhir skye ba len 'gyur gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa rnams kyang dus gcig la zhu nas ro gcig tu 'dres pa de/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje lam nas yum gyi padmar babs pa las/ yab yum gyi phung khams skye mched thams cad kyang zhu nas ngo bo bde stong dbyer med kyi chos sku yin pa la/ rnam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gcig tu gyur pa la sems 'dzin no/ /gsum pa glus bskul ba ni/ grub chen gyi gzhung las/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yi/ /myur ba nyid du bdag la bskul/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thig ler zhu ma thag tu thig le de las 'thon pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi glus bskul la/ glu ni/ oṃ ni mchog gi dngos grub ster ba la 'jug mahā su kha bde ba chen po/ badzra rdo rje ste rtogs bya'i chos dbyings/ sa twa sems dpa' ste rtogs byed kyi ye shes/ de ltar na dbyings rig dbyer med pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes zhes bos nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes pas chos sku las gzugs sku'i rnam par byon/ baṃ zhes pas de yang zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du bzhengs/ hoḥzhes pas de yang dges pa chen po'i ngang nas byon/

byon nas ci byed na/ su ra ta satwam̐ tri sha hoḥzhes pa sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzod ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bzhengs pa la gsum ste/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bskyed pa/ de la bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi bya ba/ de nyid mchod pas mnyes par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ glus bskul ba las/ thig le de sngon dmar cha gnyis su gyur/ de las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ dang / aṃ las gri gug am̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa bzhengs pa ste/ dag bya dag byed cung zad ngo sprad na/ chos kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur bas sku mdog sngon po/ 'byung bzhi rnam par dag pa dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar ba bzhi dang / 'phrin las bzhi'i ngo bo zhal bzhi/ de yang rtsa zhal ni chu khams rnam par dag pa snying rje tshad med pa'i ngo bo yin pas sngo ba/ g.yon zhal ni me khams rnam par dag pas dga' ba tshad med pa'i ngo bo yin pas dmar po/ rgyab zhal ni sa rnam par dag pa byams pa tshad med pa'i ngo bo yin pas ser po/ g.yas zhal ni rlung rnam par dag pa btang snyoms tshad med kyi ngo bo yin pas dkar po/ dus gsum gyi dngos po cig car du mkhyen pasazhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ gdug pa can 'dul bas zhal rnams mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ye shes lnga ro gcig pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrog pas dril bu 'dzin pas/ shes rab dang zung du 'jug pa'i phyir yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis gti mug las rgyal ba'i rtags su glang po bsad ma thag pa'i pags pa rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa spu dkar po phyir bstan pa smin mtshams kyi thad du khu tshur gyis brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ nang gi khrag 'dzag pa ni shes rab dang / phyi'i spu dkar po ni snying rje mtshon pas thabs shes zung 'jug go

/g.yas kyi gsum pa na gti mug gi gnyid las slong ba'i rtags su ḍa ma ru ma'i mngal gyi rus pa la spre'u'i pags pa bskon pa chu skyar gyi rkang gis ḍar rgyan byas pa/ bzhi pa na nyes pa thams cad gcod pas dgra satwa rdo rje phyed pa'i rtsa ba can gyi yu ba khru gang pa'i rtse mor dgra satwa kha bo che mang po phyed bkas pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa na srid gsum gyi nyes pa 'joms pas mdung rtse gsum pa rtsa bar rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa'i yu ba khru gang pa la rtse mor ral gri'i so lta bu gsum mo/ /drug pa na rnam rtog thams cad gcod pas rdo rje phyed pa'i yu ba can gyi gri gug 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon gyi gsum pa na thabs byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral ba mtshon pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwaṃ ka 'og gi rdo rje phyed pa'i ra lnga ni rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba thams cad yar lam la 'jug pa mtshon/ yu ba brgyad bzhogs la gyen du 'phel kha byas pa ni lam nyams su blangs pas yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba mtshon/ de'i steng gi sna tshogs rdo rje ni 'phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don byed pas sprul sku mtshon/ de'i steng gi bum pa ser po bdud rtsis gang ba ni bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin pas longs sku mtshon/ de'i steng gi thod pa dkar po sum brtsegs ni rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin yin pas chos sku mtshon/ de'i steng gi rdo rje rtse lnga pas sku gsum po re re yang ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can yin pa mtshon no/ /tshad ni 'dir lha'i phyag mtshan yin pas khru gang pa dang / rnal 'byor pa spyod pa la rgyu ba'i kha ṭwaṃ ga ni lus tshad dang mnyam pa yin no gsungs/ bzhi pa na zhags pa ni bdud dang nyon mongs pa thams cad 'ching bar byed pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i zhags pa ser po/ lnga pa na bde chen gyi ye shes la longs spyod pa mtshon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ drug pa na rnam par rtog pa thams cad bcom pa mtshon pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa'o/

/phyag bcu gnyis ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung dang lugs bzlog bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa dang / 'pho ba bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa'i yon tan mnga' ba mtshon/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pas rtag chad kyi ngo bo 'jigs byed pho mo mnan pa ni srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis dang / nyon mongs pa chags sdang gnyis mnan pa mtshon/ sku stod zlum po la mgrin pa bzhi dang bcas pa'i dbu bzhi po re re'i dbu skra rnams gyen la song ba dbu rnams kyi spyi bor thor cog bcings pa'i dbus bum pa'i rnam pa can gyi g.yon du zla ba tshes pa 'phel kha gyen la bstan pa/ phyi dang sbyar na dbang phyug gi mgo bo'i rgyan la zla ba yod pas de'i gnyen po dang / nang dang sbyar na kun da byang chub kyi sems gong du 'phel ba mtshon/ 'tshogs ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje mdun phyogs la ston rgyu'i ra rtse gyen du langs pa'i rtse mor 'dod don stsol ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che mig gsum pa 'od zer pa tra ris dang bcas pas mtshan pa/ ye shes lnga'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pas dbu re re la thod pa skam po lnga lngas brgyan pa/ nang gi yi ge ā l̥ kā l̥ lnga bcu dag pas mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ phar phyin drug rnam par dag pas spyi bo'i rus pa'i 'khor lo bsam gtan/ rna rgyan gnyis bzod pa/ mgul rgyan gnyis sbyin pa/ dpung rgyan gnyis la sogs pa'i gdu bu drug ni tshul khrims/ ske rags ni brtson 'grus/ thal ba dang mchod phyir thogs ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ gzung 'dzin spangs pas stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ 'di la sham thabs bsnams pas/ bzod pa/ grol ba dang gsum las/ 'dir grol ba'o/ /mdor na sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa sku'i nyams gsum dang / rgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung ba gsung gi nyams gsum dang /

snying rje rngam dang zhi ba thugs kyi nyams gsum dang ldan pa ste/ rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis/ 'jigs byed chen po gar gyi nyams dgur ldan/ /ces dang / kha che rin chen rdo rje'i bstod pa las/ sku yi yon tan mtshan dang dpe byad mnga'/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug nyams su shar/ /gsung gi yon tan drug cu'i dbyangs ldan nyid/ /rgod pa gshe ba 'jigs pa'i nyams su shar/ /thugs kyi yon tan gzungs dang ting 'dzin sogs/ /zhi ba sems dpa' rmad du byung ba'i nyams/ /dbang phyug chen po chags pa'i nyams bcom nas/ /zag med yum la 'khyud de 'gying bag can/ /gzhon nu gdong drug dpa' ba'i nyams bcom nas/ /'jigs byed dus mtshan g.yas brkyangs zhabs kyis mnan/ /khyab 'jug nag po drag po nyams bcom nas/ /bcu gnyis phyag can zhal bzhi sku mdog gnag /lha chen tshangs pa bzhad pa'i nyams bcom nas/ /g.yas zhal ser po bzhad pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /brgya byin mig mang zhi ba'i nyams bcom nas/ /g.yas zhal ser po bzhad pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /brgya byin mig mang zhi ba'i nyams bcom nas/ /zhal rnams re la spyan gsum yang dag ldan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /g.yas zhal ser po ni/ lū hi pa'i dbang du byas nas bstod pa yin gsungs/ yab la bshad pa'i thod pa skam rlon rus pa'i rgyan drug stag lpags rnams ni/ khaṇḍa kā pa li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo nyer bzhi la yang yod do/ /yum rdo rje phag mo ni/ kun spyod las/ mdun na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan yum/ /zhal gcig 'od 'bar chen mo ste/ /'khyud pa yi ni thod pa dang / /gdug pa bdud kyi khrag gang snod/ /g.yas pas rtag tu sdigs mdzub dang / /ma rungs pa yi gru gug bsnams/ /sku mdog dmar zhing cher 'bar ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pas sku mdog dmar mo/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas zhal gcig kun tu 'dzin pa'i mdud pa grol bas skra grol ba/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral bas gcer bu/

spyan gsum dang / thod pa'i dbu rgyan rnams ni sngar dang 'dra/ gdug pa can rnams 'dul bas phyag g.yon pas gdug pa can gyi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams nas yab la 'khyud pa/ nyon mongs pa rnams tshar gcod pas g.yas pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje gri gug gis phyogs thams cad du bsdigs par mdzad pa/ lha mo rang nyid shes rab kyi ngo bo yin pas thal ba dang mchod phyir thogs ma gtogs pa'i rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ phyi nang gi gdon thams cad sreg par byed pas bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid dang ldan zhing yab yum gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ thabs shes zung du 'jug pas zhabs kyi byin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ yab ni lhag mthong dang snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin dang / yum ni zhi gnas dang bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rtsa zhal nas bzung g.yon skor du rim bzhin dga' ba bzhi dang sku bzhi'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa byas la zhal bzhi pa'i sngags tshar gcig brjod/ chos kyi dbyings kyi nga rgyal bya ba ni/ oṃ sngar bzhin/ dharmā dhā tu chos kyi dbyings/ swa bhā wa rang bzhin/ atma ko3haṃ nga rgyal 'dzin pa ste/ sngar chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdor 'dzin bde stong gi chos sku thig ler zhu ba de/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin du bzhengs pa dngos yin snyam du nga rgyal bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi bya ba ni/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa/ ye shes pa gzhug pa bsgrub pa/ go cha bkod cing gnas gsum gnas lnga byin gyis brlabs pa nyer sgrub/ dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa sgrub pa chen po yin pa las/ dang po song zin pas/ gnyis pa ni/ snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bya zhing / smin mtshams gnad kyi sgo nas phaiṃ gyi sgra dang bcas te song /

'og min rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i thugs kar phog pas/ gtso bo yab yum la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ phyi mchod dang yid byung gis mchod nas rang la bstim mo/ /gsum pa ni/ shing gnyis gzer gyis bsdams na mi 'bral ba ltar dam tshig pa la ye shes sems dpa' bcug pa de nyid go cha'i sngags kyis mi 'bral zhing brtan par 'gyur bas/ yab la go cha'i gnas snying kha la sogs pa'i bco lnga dang / yum la lte ba la sogs pa'i gnas bcu gsum du 'god do/ /de ltar go cha gnas kyi sgo nas nyer brgyad po de la/ yab kyi go cha la yum gyi go chas 'khyud/ yum gyi de la yang yab kyis 'khyud pas nyer brgyad pa tshan pa gnyis te lnga bcu nga drug tu 'gyur ro/ /gnas gsum dang gnas lnga byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ngag 'don bzhin la/ yi ge bdun pa sogs kyi sngags rnams g.yon skor du sbrul 'khyil ba lta bur bsgom mo/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyi bcu gnyis pa rigs lnga spyan 'dren pa'am/ yang na chos rje rdo rje 'chang gi bzhed pa ltar dbang lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /gsum pa de la mchod pa bya ba la/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ mnyes mchod gsum dkyus bzhin no/ /sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la gsum ste/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du lha bskyed pa/ de dam tshig gi gnas su spro ba/ de la bsnyen sgrub yan lag bya ba'o/ /dang po ni sngar ltar 'du shes sum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde ba chen po'i sgra dang / snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi rnam par spyan drangs/

dpa' bo rnams yab kyi smin mtshams dang dpa' mo rnams yum gyi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ a wa dhu ti'i lam nas brgyud de snying kha'i bar du byon/ dbyangs dang po lte ba'i aṃ gi mes lus la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams dang / spyan drangs pa'i ye shes byon pa rnams dang / mngal skyes kyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad 'od du zhu nas yab yum gyi dbu ma'i nang na mar 'od kyi gong bu mgal me ltar 'khor zhing 'bar ba'i rnam pas song ste/ yum gyi mkha' nang du babs pas ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i gong bu de las rten dang brten par bcas pa cig char du bskyed pa'am/ yang na thig le cha gnyis su gyur nas/ cha gcig las rten gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa bskyed/ cha gcig las brten pa lha rnams bskyed do/ /de skad du/ grub chen gyi gzhung las/ snying kha'i sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs nas/ /smin ma'i bar du nges par gzhug /a wa dhu tī gnas de bzhin/ /dang po'i dbyangs dang yang dag ldan/ /de ni skad cig gis 'bar bsgom/ /mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni de bzhin no/ /'khor lo thams cad kyi ni sgo/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba du ma'o/ /zhal bzhi dpa' bo rnams kyi gtso/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor mas yongs bskor/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dam tshig gi gnas su spro ba ni/ gzhung las/ sngags pa ji ltar dbye 'dod pa/ /da nyid dbye bas tha dad yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don 'og rlung 'then tsam byas pas rlung 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros nas/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum zhal sbyor du yod pa de/ re zhig tha dad du dbye nas rtsa lam nas 'dren par byed pa ste/ 'dir phyi dkyil gyi zhar la lus dkyil bsgom dgos la/ de la thog mar mkha' nang gi des bskyed gzhi la reg pa'i rkyen gyis lus dkyil gsal 'debs so/

/bskyed gzhi ni/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba/ de'i phyogs bzhi la shar du mam̐ sngon mo/ byang du laṃ ljang ser/ nub tu paṃ dmar ser/ lhor taṃ dkar ser/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi ser skyas gang ba'i rtsa bzhi/ phyi skor 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad phyogs bzhir kha dog nyis tshogs/ mtshams bzhir kha dog phyed gzugs/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas brgyad du/ rtsa yi ge pu la sogs pa'i dbyibs can kha dog sngon po/ nang gi khams dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs can/ mchan khung la sogs pa brgyad na/ rtsa yi ge ka la sogs pa'i dbyibs can kha dog dmar po la nang gi khams dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ mtshan ma la sogs pa brgyad du rtsa yi ge tre la sogs pa'i dbyibs can kha dog dkar zhing khams dkar pos gang ba'o/ /bskyed gzhi de ltar gsal btab nas mkha' nang gi gtso bo rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying ga'i rtsa hūm̐ gi dbyibs can la reg pas/ nang gi khams bcom ldan 'das yab dang / rtsa rdo rje phag mor gyur pa sogs ngag 'don bzhin la/ nang gi he ru ka gsal 'debs pa na/ phyi'i he ru ka yang gsal 'debs te/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi gtso bo he ru ka de phyi'i he ru ka la thim pas phyi yang gsal 'debs dgos pa yin no gsungs/ de nas mkha' nang gtso mo padma'i lam nas drangs pa yum la thim/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi rdo rje'i lam nas drangs pa bskyed gzhi la reg pas/ bskyed gzhi rnal 'byor ma bzhir gyur pa phyi'i he ru'i phyag dang po bzhi la 'khod/ yar drangs pa rnams phyi'i bde chen 'khor lo'i phyogs bzhir 'khod de/ sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gsal 'debs par byed/ khyad par phyag g.yon pa rnams na thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i nang du/ glang po che sogs srog chags kyi gzugs yongs su rdzogs pa gdong phyi bstan/ kye rdor gyi g.yas kyi phyag mtshan dang 'dra/ paṇa chen nyi zla ba'i rnam bshad du yang 'di ltar bshad gsung ngo /

/snying po'i rnal 'byor ma phyag la bkod pa ni thabs shes zung 'jug mtshon pa yin te/ rnal 'byor ma ni shes rab dang / phyag mtshan ni thabs yin zhing / lha mo de dag zhal nang bstan gyi tshul gyis phyag mtshan gyi mdun ngos su bkod pas thabs shes zung 'brel du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du phyag lhag ma brgyad la ma mo brgyad bkod pa na yang 'god tshul 'di dang 'dra zhing / phyag mtshan dang thebs su sbyor ba yin te/ a bhi dha na las/ glang chen ma gtogs 'khyud ma gtogs/ /ma mo brgyad po rnams kyi thabs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ tshul 'di ni kun mkhyen rin po che go bo rab 'byams pa'i bzhed pa/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi nag po mngon rtogs su 'byung ba de'i lugs yin la/ gzhan rje btsun zhwa lu ba'i slob rgyun rnams ni ma mo snying gar bkod pa'i lugs gtso bor mdzad/ rje sems dpa' chen pos kyang 'di dang mthun pa'i yig cha yang yod/ 'on kyang rje dpal ldan rgyal po ma mo phyag bkod dang snying 'god gnyis ka bzhed pas gzhan las phul du thon pa yin no gsungs/ de nas mkha' nang gi bum thod yar drangs/ bskyed gzhi la reg pas bum thod du gyur pa de khar 'jog yar byon pa phyi'i bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams bzhir 'khod/ de bzhin du mkha' nang gi thugs 'khor gsung 'khor sku 'khor ba rnams yar drangs/ bskyed gzhi so so la reg pas lhar gyur pa de kar bzhugs/ yar byon pa rnams phyi'i 'khor lo gsum la 'khod/ mkha' nang gi sgo mtshams ma brgyad yar drangs/ bskyed gzhi phyi skor gyi hūm̐ ring po brgyad la reg pas sgo mtshams ma brgyad du gyur pa de kar bzhugs pa'am/ phyag la bkod pa lus dkyil gyi lha/ yar byon pa rnams phyi'i dam tshig 'khor lo'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad du 'khod pa ni phyi dkyil gyi lha'o/ /de ltar phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal btab cing /

de thebs pa na gsang mtha'i lam gyi zab khyad pho nya gsum bsre bar bya ste/ 'di la bsre rgyu'i pho nya ngos bzung ba/ bsre ba byed pa'i tshul bstan pa/ bsre pa'i 'thad pa bshad pa/ 'dres pa'i tshad bstan pa/ mi 'dre ba'i log rtog spang ba dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ zhing sngags lhan cig la skyes rang ngo zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi sngags skyes zhing skyes lhan skyes kyi pho nya gsum yin la/ gsum po 'di yang blo'i spyod yul yongs su rdzogs pa gcig dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa gcig dang / mngon par rtogs pa tshar gcig la brtsi ba'i tshul dang gsum yod do/ /gnyis pa bsre tshul ni/ las dang po pas lha dang rtsibs re re nas bsre/ 'bring gis 'khor lo re re nas bsre/ rab kyis rten dang brten par bcas pa kun dus gcig la bsre ba yin no/ /de yang bdag gi bsgom pa'i sngags skyes lha drug cu rtsa gnyis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di rnams phyi rol 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor yin la/ de yang 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes kyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor yin zhing / de yang chos kyi sku dang tha mi dad pa yin no snyam pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa ste/ oṃ zhes pa'i skabs su sngags skyes dang zhing skyes dang / lhan skyes kyi sku 'khor gsum po dran par bya/ a zhes pa'i skabs su gsung 'khor gsum po/ hūm̐ zhes pa'i skabs su thugs 'khor gsum po dran par bya/ sarwa ni thams cad/ wi ra ni dpa' bo/ yo gi ni rnal 'byor/ kā ya sku/ wā ka gsung / tsitta thugs/ badzra rdo rje/ swa bhā wa rang bzhin/ atma ko3haṃ nga yin zhes pa'o/ /mdor na pho nya gsum gyi sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin de nga yin snyam pa'o/ /badzra shuddha sogs ni chos thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du rnam par dag

de yang dkyil 'khor dngos rang yin snyam du bsam pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gsol ba mas 'debs byin gyi yas rlobs pa'i phyir 'dre ste/ bdag gis bsgom pa'i sngags skyes de zhing skyes su bsgom/ de yang lhan skyes su bsgom/ de chos sku tha mi dad du bsgoms pas/ chos sku'i byin rlabs lhan skyes la zhugs/ de'i byin rlabs zhing skyes la zhugs/ de'i byin rlabs bsgrub pa po la zhugs te/ blo snang la bsgom pa'i sngags skyes kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang ba'i bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin bzang po rang shugs kyis skye'o/ /bzhi pa 'dres pa'i tshad ni/ sngags skyes zhing skyes su bsgoms pas de gnyis tha dad du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa spangs nas zhing skyes dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal skyes pa dang / de bzhin du zhing skyes la lhan skyes kyi nga rgyal dang / lhan skyes la chos sku dngos rang yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal byung ba ni 'dres pa'i tshad yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ sngags skyes la lha drug cu rtsa gnyis tshang ma yod la/ 'dzam bu'i gling na zhing skyes nyi shu rtsa bzhi las med/ 'og min na yang bde chen lha lnga las med pas grangs mi mthun pa'i phyir mi 'dre'o snyam na skyon med de/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang 'og min gnyis na yang lha tshang ma yod la/ gal te khyed zer ba bzhin gyi lha grangs las med na yang / 'khor la bsres pas gtso bo la bsres par 'gyur/ gtso bo la bsres pas 'khor la yang bsres par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper na 'jig rten na yang 'khor mnyes pas dpon mnyes pa dang / dpon mnyes pas 'khor yang mnyes pa bzhin no/ /mdor na zhing skyes kyi dpa' bo khaṇḍa kā pa li pa lta bu gcig dang / lhan skyes kyi mkha' 'gro ma lta bu zhig gi lus la yang lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor tshang ma yod pas/

de gnyis la bsres pas kyang gtso 'khor thams cad la bsres par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa de la bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi bya ba ni/ phyi nang gi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed cing gsal btab dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag bshad ma thag pa de yin la/ gnyis pa bsgrub pa'i yan lag ye shes pa gzhug pa ni sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi ye shes pa spyan drang bya/ sngags ni phaiṃ zhes pa'o/ /phyag rgya ni/ kun spyod las/ rkang pa mnan te steng du blta/ /steng du phaiṃ kyi sgra sgrog la/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams gnas pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dgug /sngags kyi yan lag bskul ba dang / /skad cig de la spyan drangs ba /mdzub mo 'dud byas gung mo nges par sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan po yang dag sbyar/ /'di ni dpral ba'i phyogs kyi dbus bzhag la/ /gcu zhing gcu zhing bskor ba byas pa yi/ /sngags pas dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma byin brlabs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba g.yon du bskor ba'o/ /ting nge 'dzin ni/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros/ smin mtshams gnad kyi sgo phye nas phaiṃ sgra dang bcas nas song / 'og min gyi longs sku'i thugs gar phog pas/ de las sprul pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam la phyi mchod dang yid byung gis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa la dgug gzhug sogs bya/ rnam lnga 'dod skor dang 'khyud rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sogs brjod/ de yang chos thams cad rnal 'byor gyi ngo bor rnam par dag pa nga yin zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa nyer sgrub kyi yan lag go cha bkod pa sogs ni/ shing gnyis phan tshun gzer gyis bsdams pa bzhin du dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bstims pa'i rjes la go cha bkod pa nā ro ta pa'i man ngag yin gsungs/

de lta bu'i go cha la don drug ste/ gang la 'god pa'i gzhi/ gang du 'god pa'i gnas/ der 'god pa'i gdan/ ji ltar du 'god pa'i tshul/ ji tsam 'god pa'i grangs/ ji ltar bkod pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ phyi dkyil gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dang / nang dkyil la thugs 'khor la mig gnyis dang phrag pa gnyis gnas kyi dbye bas/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo zhal sbyor bcu/ gsung 'khor la mchan khung gnyis/ 'doms bar gyi 'bras bu gnyis kyi dbye bas bcu gcig sku 'khor la/ brla gnyis/ byin pa gnyis/ sor mo bcu drug bol gong gnyis/ mthe bong bzhi/ pus mo gnyis kyi gnas lhag po'i dbye bas sum cu/ kun dril 'khor lo gsum la lnga bcu nga gcig 'byung ba las/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo re re nas bgrangs na brgya dang gnyis/ de steng du phyag la bkod pa'i ma mo bcu gnyis/ snying kha'i he ru ka yab yum gnyis te bcu bzhi bsnan pas lus dkyil gyi lha brgya dang bcu drug phyi dkyil gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pas brgya dang bdun cu don brgyad ni go cha gang la 'god pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i lha yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyi nang gi lha brgya dang don brgyad po re re la dpa' bo'i go cha 'god pa'i gnas snying kha dang / spyi bo dang / spyi gtsug dang / phrag pa gnyis dang / mig gnyis dang / tshigs chen brgyad de bco lnga dang / dpa' mo'i go cha 'god pa'i gnas lte ba dang / snying ga dang / kha dang / spyi bo dang / spyi gtsug dang / tshigs chen brgyad de bcu gsum/ kun dril bas nyi shu rtsa brgyad re yod par rje bzang po dpal ba'i nag po zin bris kyi lugs bzhin 'dir 'chad do/ /de skad du/ kun spyod las/ snying ga spyi bo spyi gtsug dang / /phrag pa mig gnyis lus la sbyar/ /zhes pas dpa' bo'i go cha 'god pa'i gnas bco lnga dang / lte ba snying kha de bzhin kha/ /spyi bo spyi gtsug yan lag nyid/ /ces pas dpa' mo'i go cha 'god pa'i gnas bcu gsum ston no/

/lus la zhes pa dang / yan lag nyid ces pa'i don tshigs chen brgyad ni lag pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis/ pus mo gnyis/ bol gong gnyis rnams so/ /lag pa'i mkhrig ma la tshigs su 'jog pa rje btsun zha lu ba'i lugs yin la/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i bde chen bcud snying ltar na/ lag pa'i gru mo g.yas g.yon la tshigs chen du 'jog pa yin gsung ngo / /gsum pa gdan ni/ go cha 'god pa'i gnas kun tu zla ba'i gdan re re bsam pa'o/ /bzhi pa ji ltar 'god pa'i tshul ni/ a bha dhi na'i lugs gcig la go cha thams cad lha'i rnam par bshad cing / rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las yi ge'i rnam par bshad/ da lta phyag len la ngo bo lha yin pa la/ rnam pa yig 'brur bsgom ste/ lha nyid sngags kyi gzugs kyis ni/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang dpa' bo'i go cha so so la dpa' mo'i go cha 'khyud/ dpa' mo'i go cha so so la dpa' bo'i go chas 'khyud par bsgom ste/ dper na snying gar/ oṃ oṃ ha dkar po la oṃ oṃ baṃ dmar mos 'khyud/ lte ba'i gnas su de las bzlog pa dang / mgo bor oṃ na ma hi ser po la/ oṃ haṃ yoṃ sngon mos 'khyud cing / snying ga'i oṃ haṃ yoṃ la oṃ na ma his 'khyud pa dang / spyi gtsug tu oṃ swahā hūm̐ dmar po la oṃ hriṃ moṃ dkar mos 'khyud cing / khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo la spyi gtsug gi oṃ swāhā hus 'khyud pa dang / phrag pa gnyis su oṃ bāauṣṭa he nag po la/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ ser mos 'khyud pa dang / dpral ba'i hriṃ hriṃ ser mo la/ bāauṣṭas 'khyud pa dang / mig gnyis su oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser la oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gus 'khyud cing / spyi gtsug gi oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu la oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser gyis 'khyud pa dang / tshigs chen brgyad du yang oṃ phaṭ haṃ ljang khu la oṃ phaṭ phaṭ dud khas 'khyud cing / yang oṃ phaṭ phaṭ brgyad la yang oṃ phaṭ ham̐ ljang gus 'khyud par bsam pa yin no/

/tshul 'di ni mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma bcu gnyis/ /re re'i gnas su nges par sbyar/ /zhes dang / a bhi dha na las/ go cha gnyis po 'di dag ni/ /'khor lo kun la rnam bsgoms nas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ /de lta bu'i dpa' bo'i go cha drug ni rdo rje sems dpa' sogs rgyal ba rigs drug gi ngo bo dang / dpa' mo'i go cha drug ni/ rdo rje phag mo sogs dpa' mo drug gi ngo bo yin te/ kun spyod las/ dang po rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /gnyis pa rnam par snang mdzad gnas/ /gsum pa padma gar dbang rgyal/ /bzhi pa he ru ka dpal bshad/ /lnga pa rdo rje nyi ma ste/ /drug pa la ni rta mchog yin/ /zhes dang / dang po rdo rje phag mo ste/ /gnyis pa la mi ni ru bshad/ /gsum pa rmongs byed ma nyid de/ /bzhi pa bskyod ma yin par bshad/ /lnga pa kun tu skrag par grags/ /drug pa gtum mo yin par bshad/ /go cha drug nyid phag mo dang / /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /lnga pa grangs ni/ lha re re'i sku lus la go cha'i lha zung du byas na nyer brgyad/ ya 'phral na lnga bcu nga drug yod pas/ thams cad sdom pa la dgu stong dgu brgya dang drug cu re brgyad yod de/ man ngag gi sdom tshigs su bcad pa las/ 'god gzhi brgya dang don brgyad la/ /'god byed lha ni lnga bcu drug /bkod pas dgu stong dgu brgya dang / /drug cu re brgyad 'byung ba ni/ /go cha'i lha grangs yin par nges/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /lugs 'di la snying ga spyi bo spyi gtsug tshigs chen brgyad rnams su go cha gnyis tshan pa gnyis gnyis pa ste ya phral na bzhi bzhi/ mig gnyis phrag pa gnyis su dpa' bo la dpa' mos 'khyud pa'i go cha gnyis tshan pa re dang / lte ba dang khar dpa' mo la dpa' bos 'khyud pa'i go cha tshan pa re re/ ya phral na gnyis gnyis su 'gyur ba yin no/ /go cha de rnams yab rkyang yum rkyang ma yin pa zhal sbyor du gnyis tshan pa re gnas pa ni/

sngar drangs pa'i rgyud de rnams kyis grub cing / mngon rtogs 'don cha las kyang / yab kyi gnas su yum dang / yum gyi gnas su yab gnyis su med par gyur ces gsungs so/ /drug pa phan yon ni/ go cha bkod pas bsrung ba chen por 'gyur te/ spyi bo dang spyi gtsug dang / yan lag la go cha bkod pas lus kyi sgo thams cad kyi bar chad bsrung / mig la bkod pas mig gi rnam shes rnam rtog sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i bar chad bsrung / snying la bkod pas yid kyi bar chad bsrung / yum gyi go chas ni ngag gi bar chad bsrung ba yin no/ /gnas gsum gnas lnga byin rlabs ni/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa dbang bskur ba bsgrub pa chen po'i yan lag la/ gang la dbang bskur ba'i yul/ gang gis dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor/ ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ phyi nang gi lha brgya dang don brgyad la'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha spyan 'dren pa ste/ 'di la rigs mi mthun gyi gdan gsum tshang ba dang / rigs mthun gyi gdan gsum tshang ba gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma yin la/ gdan gsum tshang tshul ni/ dbang lha drug cu rtsa gnyis spyan drangs pa'i bde chen lha lnga ni gshegs pa dang gshegs ma'i gdan/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams ni/ sems dpa' dang sems ma'i gdan/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni/ khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan yin no/ /gsum pa dbang bskur tshul ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ sngon gyi tshigs bcad 'di yis ni/ /dbang bskur ba ni nod par bya/ /zhes gsungs la/ sngon gyi tshigs bcad gang yin na/ ji ltar bltams pa zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad yin la/ 'di sngags dang bcas pa'i bum pa'i chus phyi nang gi lha thams cad la dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma dag lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi nyams myong rgyud la skyes/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum dang / 'khor gyi lha shar phyogs pa rnams la mi bskyod pa/

byang phyogs pa rnams la don yod grub pa sogs ngag 'don ltar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin bstan zin to// ༈ //gsum pa las rgyal mchog la/ sngags mchod/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ mnyes mchod/ yid byung gi mchod pa/ bstod pa'i mchod pa/ dag pa dran pa dang bdun no/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ sngags rnams kun gyi mchod pa dang / /zhes gsungs pas sngags mchod bstan la/ byed tshul ni/ lha gsal btab ste de la dmigs pa rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags nas bzung / sngags kun tshar gcig 'don pa'o/ /gnyis pa phyi mchod ni/ rang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas ser snas kun nas bslangs pa'i las ngan rgyu 'bras rnams dang / khyad par dad rdzas gshin rdzas zos pa rnams mdun du spungs la/ bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ thod pa'i snod chen po bdun gyi nang du mchod pa bdun tshan pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba blos sprul te/ rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la mchod par bsams la/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod lnga ngag 'don ltar 'bul lo/ /gsum pa nang mchod ni/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs gtor ma ltar byas la/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis g.yon nas lan gsum bskor te dbus nas blangs la mchod do/ /de yang nā ro rtsa rkyang gi lugs la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ mthe bong zhes bya rdo rje ste/ /ming med ces bya bha gar brjod/ /de nyid kha yi sgo blangs nas/ /rang gi lhag pa'i zhal du'o/ /dang po bla mar dbul nas ni/ /de rjes sangs rgyas rnams la dbul/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mthe bong rdo rje dang / ming med steng srin lag padmar bsam la/ mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin du bsams la/ mtheb srin gyis blangs la mchod pas/ gzhi thod pa las de 'dra ba re chad nas lha thams cad kyi phyag g.yon du phul bas ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi gsol/

thugs rgyud la lhan skyes kyi ye shes rgyas par bsam/ mthar gzhi thod byang shar gyi gshin rje 'joms ma'i phyag tu phul te/ sgrub pa po tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel yin no/ /rje sems dpa' chen po'i phyag len la/ yab yum zhal sbyor la bdud rtsi 'thor thengs lan gnyis re byed gsungs/ bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la/ rgyas par na re re'i mtshan gyi mjug tu 'bru gsum btags la 'bul/ bsdu na mngon rtogs kyi nang gi ngag 'don ltar bya/ lha rnams la yang lha rang rang gi sngags brjod de gsal thebs pa dang bstun 'bru gsum btags la phul ba phyag len rgyas pa la bya dgos gsungs/ bsdu na hūm̐ aṃ maṃ laṃ la sogs pa'i mthar 'bru gsum btags nas 'bul ba 'di yin te/ 'di la yang lha rnams gsal thebs tsam re dgos gsungs/ de nas chos skyong sogs la 'bru gsum btags nas phul/ bzhi pa mnyes mchod ni/ de ltar mchod pas lha thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bde chen ye shes kyis gang ba'i zhal nas yi ge bdun pa brjod par bsams nas/ rang gis yi ge bdun pa dngos su brjod cing / rnam lnga dang 'dod skor pad skor gyi phyag rgya dang por snying kha'i dbus su bya/ de nas nu kha g.yas su/ de nas dbus su/ de nas g.yon du/ yang dbus su bya zhing / mthar 'khyud rgya byas la oṃ sarwa ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta sogs brjod do/ /lnga pa yid byung ni sngar bzhin no/ /drug pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod cing / spro na rgyal ba sprul pa ma dang chos dbyings rnam dag ma la sogs pas kyang bstod do/ /bdun pa dag pa dran pa ni/ lha rnams sngags nas bshad pas bzang la/ byang phyogs rnams pha rol tu phyin pa nas bshad pas ngan snyam pa'i log rtog bzlog pa'i phyir/ mkha' 'gro ma ni lus rjes su dran pa'o/ /lā ma ni tshor ba rjes su dran pa'o zhes sogs phar ngag tu bya/ yang lha nyid ni rang gi lus la bskyed pas ngan/

byang phyogs ni sems gnyis med kyi ye shes yin pas bzang snyam na/ de'i log rtog bzlog pa'i phyir/ lus rjes su dran pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /zhes sogs tshur ngag tu sbyar nas nyams su len no/ las rgyal mchog bstan zin to/ /da ni bskyed pa'i rim pa snang la rang bzhin med pa'i dkyil 'khor la sems 'dzin par bya ste/ bde mchog pa gsung gi 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ thog mar gtso bo'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la sems 'dzin/ de yang rtsa zhal sngon po/ de nas g.yon zhal dmar po/ rgyab zhal ser po/ g.yas zhal dkar po rnams la sems 'dzin/ de nas zhal rnams kyi shangs dang / spyan dang / khro gnyer dang / snyan dang / rgyan cha rnams dang / phyag rnams dang / yum rdo rje phag mo rnams la sems 'dzin/ de nas bde chen 'khor lo sogs 'khor lo lnga dang gzhal yas khang dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin/ de nas yul 'khor gcig dang / lung pa gcig dang / gling bzhi dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams dang rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsgoms te sems 'dzin/ mthar nam mkhas khyab pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dkyil 'khor du bsgoms nas sems 'dzin/ de la bogs dbyung ba dang rtsal sbyang ba'i phyir/ de thams cad bdag bskyed la bsres te bsgom/ re 'ga' de thams cad yungs 'bru tsam dang / res de thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i chen po zhig tu bsgom/ res 'ga' dkyil 'khor yungs 'bru tsam gcig gi nang du khams gsum thams cad btsud de/ khams gsum chung du ma song ba yungs 'bru cher ma song ba/ yang dkyil 'khor yungs 'bru tsam gcig gis khams gsum thams cad la khyab par bsgoms pas yungs 'bru che ru ma song khams gsum chung du ma song ba'o/ /'di dag tshul bzhin du byung na bskyed pa'i rim pa mthar phyin pa'i tshad do/ /gong gi gnyis pa brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/

dpyid thig gi dmigs pa nyams su len pa yin la/ 'di la 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa 'phags pa rin po che'i sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba'i nang gi dmigs pa de rgyas pa tsam du bzhugs/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsung 'bum gyi nang na de las bsdus pa'i 'bring po tsam dang / rje bzang po dpal bas rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan rgyal po'i gsung la zin bris mdzad pa'i dpyid thig de/ bsdus pa dmigs pa gcig ma rgyun du nyams su len pa 'di yin la/ 'di dang zhwa lu mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub kyis mdzad pa'i dpyid thig dmigs gcig ma gnyis la khyad par med cing brgyud pa yang gnyis char dang ldan te/ rje bzang po dpal ba'i de mkhan chen chos dbang phyug la gsan/ zhwa lu mkhyen rab pas ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub nas brgyud pa 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho las gsan pa yin gsungs/ dmigs pa dngos ni zur du blta'o/ /mnyam bzhag gi rnal 'byor rim gnyis bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la bzhi ste/ bzlas pa'i bgrangs phreng / bzlas pa'i grangs/ bzla bya'i sngags/ bzla dus kyi dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ a bhi dha na las/ dung chen phreng ba blangs nas ni/ /mthe bong srin lag dag gis bgrangs/ /zhes gsungs pas thod phreng nyid gtso bor bshad do/ /gnyis pa grangs ni/ mchog bsgrub pa'i bzlas pa la ni grangs med la/ dbang bskur ba la sogs pa rdo rje slob dpon du bsgrub pa'i bzlas pa la/ rab rtsa sngags gnyis/ snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis/ go cha gnyis rnams la 'bum phrag bzhi 'khor rnams la khri phrag bzhi bzhi dang bcas pa bzla bar bzhed/ 'bring na gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis rnams la 'bum phrag bzhi bzhi/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag bzhi bzhi bzlas nas/ rtsa sngags dang go cha ji tsam nus pa bzlas shing / zhal bzhi pa'i sngags ni bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir/ thun gyi thog mthar nyer gcig gam/

bdun nam lnga'am gsum tsam re bzla/ glo bo mkhan chen gyi phyag len la/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brgya tsam re bzla/ yab yum gyi snying po gnyis la 'bum phrag bzhi re bzlas nas/ nye snying gnyis la 'bum phrag re bzlas kyang chog 'khor gyi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad la bsnyen pa kha gso'i dus ltar stong phrag lnga dang lnga brgya re bzlas pas chog par mdzad/ lugs 'di yang rje rdo rje 'chang nas gu ge paṇḍi ta la brgyud pa yin zhing / deng sang gdan sa chen po na phyag len yod pa 'di yon gsungs/ rtsa sngags gnyis gnyis su med pa'i don ni/ yab kyi rtsa sngags tshar gcig brjod pa'i rjes la/ yum gyi rtsa sngags kyang tshar gcig brjod te cha mnyam du bzlas pa lta bu la gnyis su med pa zer/ de bzhin du snying po gnyis gnyis su med pa sogs la yang 'gre/ sgrub pa po bsnyen pa bskyal ba'i tshe/ snying po nye snying lta bu la mtshon na/ dang por yab kyi snying po la 'bum phrag bzhi'i grangs bzung / de bar la sngags gzhan ci rigs pa bzla/ de nas yum gyi snying po la grangs 'dzin pa sogs rkang thon du bzlas kyang chog nā ro pa chen po'i lugs kyi ro gcig pa'i bzlas pa ni/ yab yum gyi nye snying la mtshon na/ oṃ hrī ha ha badzra bāai ro tsa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ ces pa lta bu'o/ /rin chen bzhi la bsnyen pa skyel ba na yang / thog mar snying po nye snying 'khor rnams dang bcas pa la grangs tshad bskyal te/ de nas rtsa sngags la 'bungs kyang chog pa yin no/ /kha gso'i bsnyen pa ni/ nag po pa'i dbang bskur lta bu byed na/ bsnyen pa kha gso re byed pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa'i phyag len la yod la/ grangs ni/ nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil chog las/ dpa' bo'i snying po'i gsang sngags ni/ /khri phrag gsum du bzlas brjod bya/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo'i/

/khri phrag gnyis ni bsnyen pa bya/ /ka kha'i gdong sogs brgyad po dang / /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ni/ /stong phrag lnga dang lnga brgya ni/ /sngon du bsnyen pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di la yang bum pa la brten nas byed pa dang / bum pa la ma brten par mdun gyi nam mkhar lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed nas byed pa'i lugs gnyis yod do/ /bzla bya'i sngags ni grangs kyi skabs las rtogs so/ /bzla dus kyi dmigs pa ni/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mthar mdun nas brtsams te rtsa sngags kyis g.yon skor du tshar gcig bskor bar bsam/ de'i nang du snying po nye snying gis rim bzhin du g.yon du bskor/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste yab kyi zhal nas thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i aṃ la thim pas yum gyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum thams cad bsdus/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud bha ga nas thon rdo rje'i lam nas brgyud thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par bsams la gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags rnams bzla/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags la hūm̐ las sngags de dang de thon nas yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal na mar song ba sogs 'khor tshul sngar dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par ni sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer 'phros/ sngags gang bzla ba'i lha de dang de la phog pas dbang du 'dus par bsam la bzla/ sngags kyi kha dog ni gtso bo dkar po'o/ /gsum pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rdo rje'i chus dam tshig gi gzungs su/ nas kyi zan las byas pa'i gtor ma padma'i dbyibs can mdun du bzhag la zhes gsungs pas/ padma'i lte ba ltar zlum po mtheb kyang pad 'dab kyi dbyibs can bzhi'am brgyad kyis bskor ba gsum mam gnyis gang rung bshams la/ bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ gtor mgron ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros bdag bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad du phog pas/ bdag bskyed dang bcas pa'i yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor cha dgur gyur/

phaiṃ la sogs pas dkyil 'khor cha brgyad spyan drangs/ dur khrod brgyad kyi de la bstims/ de nas gtor sngags tshar drug gam lngas dbul/ tshar dang po'i tshe gtso bo yab yum gyis ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs nas bzhes par bsam/ lan gnyis pa la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang / gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar la thugs 'khor ba nas sgo mtshams ma'i bar dang sbyar/ de yang dkyil 'khor cha dgu yod pas dgu tshan pa re dang sbyar ro/ /lan lngas 'bul na/ lan dang po la dkyil 'khor cha dgu'i bde chen 'khor lo lha lngas bzhes par bsam/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ ka ra ka ra la sogs pa ni 'dir brjod kyang gtor sngags ni ma yin gsungs/ de nas mchod bstod smon lam la sogs pa ni dkyus bzhin no/ /yang mdun bskyed dang 'brel na/ mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad du dkyil 'khor cha brgyad bsams nas/ mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor cha dgu la gtor ma 'bulab yin/ dus rgyun du yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ram lha'i bris thang lta bu yod na der gtor mgron bskyed nas gtor ma phul/ brtan bzhugs byas na rab gnas su yang 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'bul ba'o/ /'di la 'jig rten pa'i gtor mar bshad kyang / gtor mgron ni gtso bor zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku rnams yin la/ 'on kyang 'khor du gtogs pa la 'jig rten rang rgyud pa yang yod do/ /de nas mgon po lcam dral la yang gtor ma nges par 'bul dgos te/ lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma 'dis bram ze mchog sred nas bzung / deng sang gi bar du 'khor lo bde mchog sgrub pa po rnams kyi bar chad bsrung zhing mthun rkyen thams cad bsgrub pa yin no/ /de skad du/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/

dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa la sogs pa'i/ /ma rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor bstan zin to/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la oṃ oṃ ha sogs kyi yab yum gyi go cha dang / spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhir/ pu dang dza la sogs pa'i yi ge gsal gdab pa go cha chen po dang / sumbha ni lan gnyis kyis tsham ngam sngags kyi bsrungs nas/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas snang ba thams cad lha dang / yab kyi rkang brgyad brjod pas grags pa thams cad sngags dang / yang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ dran rtog thams cad ye shes kyi rol par bsam mo/ /de ltar na 'di dag ni/ sbyin bya bzhi brlab bya gnyis grogs spyod pa gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar nas/ 'bras bu 'grub pa'i lam rim gyi nang tshan bslab bya dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa yin la/ 'di dag tshul bzhin du ston pa'i go rim ni nag po pa la mtshon na/ thog mar blo sbyong byed zhen pa bzhi bral la sogs pas rgyud sbyangs te/ bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par byas pa de la/ nag po dkyil chog las sbyin bya dbang bzhi sbyin nas lam ston pa'i snod rung du byas/ de nas bslab bya dang po bskyed rim bsgom pa la/ bskyed rim gyi bshad bka' rgyas pa byas te nag po mngon rtogs tshul bzhin du bsgom/ de'i rjes su rdzogs rim gyi thig le rgyas bsdus rigs drug dang / nag po rim bzhi dang / rim bzhi lam slong rnams rim pas ston cing bsgom pa ni mus chen sems dpa' chen po nas deng sang gi bar du phyag len ma nyams par bzhugs pa yin/ gzhan dag dbang tsam bskur nas nag po rim bzhi la sogs pa ston cing / bskyed rim gyi bshad bka' mi mdzad pa yod kyang / rje rdo rje 'chang gi lugs ma 'chugs pa la mus pa'i lugs 'di bzhin du bya dgos so gsungs/ gnad 'di dag bshad yam gyi tshul du gsungs kyang blo la 'jems par byung nas dkyus su bkod pa dpyod ldan dag gis snying la gces so/

/thun mtshams su kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang 'khor lo bde mchog gi nga rgyal gyis bza' ba dang btung ba rnams gtor ma bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ yang na oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la phud mchod dang / 'byung po la chang bu sogs spyi dang mthun par byas rjes/ rang phyi'i he ru ka yab yum la nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor lha drug cu rtsa gnyis skad cig gis gsal lam ste btab la/ kha thab khung / lag pa dgang gzar dgang blugs kha zas bsreg rdzas su bsams la/ lus kyi lte ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar te lha mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyad pas phyi nang gi lha thams cad tshim par bsam/ 'di la g.yon gyi kun spyod gtso che ba'i phyir/ kham dang po de lag pa g.yon pas bcad nas bza' bar bya/ de nas ci bder byas kyang chog gsungs/ de ltar byas pas kha zas bu lon du mi 'gyur zhing / lha mchod pas tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba yin no/ /khyad par 'dir lag pa'i mchod pa tshul bzhin du byas na dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad mnyes par 'gyur zhing / sgrub pa po rang nyid longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa sogs bsam pa'i don thams cad 'bad mi dgos par/ ji ltar 'dod pa rnams rang gi yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no/ /don 'di la dgongs nas/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud las/ lag pa mchod pas rnal 'byor pa/ /dbul sel 'dod don 'grub par 'gyur/ /bsam mi dgos par 'gyur ba yin/ /bza' btung gos sogs thob par 'gyur/ /lha yi mchod pa byas na ni/ /de yis bsam pa rnams 'grub 'gyur/ /dpa' bo 'di ni dpa' chen po/ /sa steng rnal 'byor ma rnyed dka'/ /rnal 'byor pa yi spyod brtul zhugs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun gyi gtso/ /gang zhig rtag tu 'dis rab mchod/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub kun rab ster/

/zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /kha zas kyi rnal 'byor bshad zin to/ /de dag gis ni grub chen nag po pa lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs bshad pa bstan zin nas/ gsum pa grub chen dril bu pa lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs bshad pa la/ de yang rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi phyi nang gi bskyed pa'i rim pa nyams su len pa la/ rten gyi gang zag gsum ste/ las dang po pa'i thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la brten nas lha mngal skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa nyams su len cing sbyin sreg dang bzlas pa gtso bor 'don/ de la brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag gis sgong skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa bsgom zhing bzlas pa dang sbyin sreg kha skong tsam byed/ gtso bor lha'i rnam pa la sems 'dzin/ de'ang phyi'i bskyed rim gtso bor bya zhing / nang zhar byung gi tshul du nyams su blangs so/ /de nas brtan pa cher thob pa'i gang zag gis nang bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa yin te/ grub chen gyi gzhung du/ 'gro kun don la rab gzhol ba/ /rang rgyud sngags dang rnal 'byor shes/ /phyi rol rnam rtog spangs pa'o/ /dam tshig mnyam nyid rnal 'byor che/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de nyid a bhi dha na las kyang 'byung ngo / /don ni rim pa bzhin byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sogs thun mong ba'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs pa dang / rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi sngags rin chen bzhi la sogs pa dang / lha'i rnal 'byor nyams su len legs par shes pa/ phyi rol gyi rnam rtog spangs pa ni/ phyi rol gzung 'dzin du zhen pa'i rtog pa spangs pa la 'bru bsnan na rung ba tsam du snang yang / de ltar na'ang bde mchog la shin tu mkhas pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyis phyi bskyed rim gyi rnam rtog spangs pa la 'bru snon par mdzad cing / de yang phyi'i bskyed rim gtan nas 'bor ba ni ma yin te/

tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus su nyams su len dgos pa yin mod kyang / de ltar na yang phyi'i bskyed rim rten 'byung ba rim brtsegs/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa bsgom pa dang / brten pa lha mngon byang lnga las rgyu 'bras kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa dang / rten dang brten pa cig char du bsgom pa'i bskyed rim gyi spros pa'i mtshan mas yid dub pa'i gang zag des spros pa'i mtshan ma chung bas nang lus dkyil gyi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas bde stong gi ye shes rtogs par 'dod pa don du gnyer ba'o/ /dam tshig mnyam nyid rnal 'byor che/ /zhes pa ni/ bza' ba dang bsrung ba la sogs pa'i dam tshig dang / mnyam nyid ces pa ni chos thams cad mnyam nyid du cung zad rtogs pa'o/ /gzhung gang la brten nas nyams su len na rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bshad pa'i rgyud lnga char la brten no/ /de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi drang don du 'chad pa la/ tshogs bshad kyi tshe mngal sgong gi mngon par rtogs pa gnyis ston/ slob bshad kyi tshe brdzus skyes kyi mngon par rtogs pa ston te/ rtsa rgyud kyi gleng gzhi las/ gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu 'gyur/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan pa/ /mkha' 'gro kun dngos sems dpa' ni/ /zhes pa 'dis lus dkyil mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bstan te/ gsang bas rkang mthil gyi rlung bstan/ mchog gis sum mdo'i me bstan/ dgyes pas lte ba'i chu/ thams cad bdag nyid kyis grangs kyi sa bstan/ rtag tu bzhugs kyis sgal tshigs ri rab dang / mgo bo ri rab kyis stod kyi cha bstan/ mkha' 'gro kun dngos ni rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis po yin la/ de la mkha' 'gro kun zhes bya ste/ de yang / mkha' 'gro ma ni re res zhing / 'khor ni bye ba dag dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs la/ de'i mkha' 'gro grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams bsdu na/

stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su 'dus/ de bdun cu rtsa gnyis su 'du/ de sum cu rtsa bdun du bsdus pa'i mkha' 'gro ma lus pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin pas so/ /sems dpa' ni bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rten byang sems sum cu bdun po la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /ces pas thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo snying ga na gnas pa'i hūm̐ bstan te/ de'i shugs la snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo bstan no/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan pa/ /zhes pas de lta bu'i lus dkyil thams cad kyang kun rdzob tu blos rtog pas bcos nas bsgom pa ma yin gyis/ grub tsam nyid nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du rang byung du byung bar bstan no/ /'chad byed kyi man ngag ni grub chen dril bu pas mdzad pa'i gzhung nyid la brten no/ /de la yang grub chen des mdzad pa'i dril bu lus dkyil dang / lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs dang / dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dang / dril bu pas mdzad pa'i gzhung chung rnams yod par grags pa las/ lha lnga'i sgrub thabs de la grub mtha' mi mthun pa 'ga' re snang bas grub chen gyis mdzad pa yin min dpyad dgos la/ gzhung rnam dag cig ni yin par bshad cing / dril bu gzhung chung du grags pa de sa skya pa gong ma'i phyag dpe rnying pa dag nas rje btsun pu hrang pas mdzad pa'o zhes gsungs pa ltar don la gnas pa yin no zhes rje rdo rje 'chang bzhed do/ /lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs de jo bo nā ro ta pa nas brgyud pa la med kyang dga' ba'i rdo rje nas brgyud de rje btsun ba ri lo tsā bas rje sa skya pa la gnang ba yin zhing grub chen gyis mdzad par nges pa yin no/ /lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs de nyid las/ rnal 'byor gsum du shes bya ste/ byin gyis brlabs dang yongs brtags dang / /gzugs nyid yongs su gyur pa der/

/rnal 'byor sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags/ /zhes 'byung zhing / de'i don yongs su brtags pa'i rnal 'byor/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor/ gzugs yongs su gyur pa'i rnal 'byor dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ phyi bskyed rim mo/ /gnyis pa ni grub chen gyis mdzad pa'i nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ gsum pa ni rim pa lnga'i dang po bzhi rdzogs nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas skabs su sems stong par zhugs pa/ stong pa sems su zhugs pa gnyis las stong pa sems su zhugs pa ste/ rgyas par gzhan du 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o/ /des na phyi nang gnyis kyi nang nas nang bskyed pa'i rim pa/ rnal 'byor gsum gyi nang nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bshad pa'i rgyud lnga nas 'byung ba'i man ngag ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas grub chen dril bu pa la dngos su gnang ba'i man ngag lus dkyil gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni gtan la dbab par bya ba'i chos so/ /de la de nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag lam mngon par rtogs pa/ 'bras bu bshad pa'o/ /rten gyi gang zag ni gong du bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa la mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ /go rim de yang nyams len gyi rim pa bzhin bstan pa yin te/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshe/ dang por bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom/ de las langs te thun mtshams su rjes spyod kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len/ de nas kha zas kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len/ grub na thun bzhi'i mjug tu gtor ma'i rnal 'byor dang / ma grub na yang thun tha ma srod thun gyi rjes la gtor ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len dgos pas so/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/ dang po la sngon 'gro tshogs bsags pa dang /

dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la tshogs bsags pa'i sngon du 'gro ba dga' ba gsum sgom pa dang tshogs bsags dngos so/ /dang po ni nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal la/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis ldang / rnal 'byor gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus bya/ stan bde ba la kha lho phyogs su bstan la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'dug bdud rtsi ril bus kha dag par bya/ med na khar bzhag pa'i mos pa bya/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu rang la thim pas/ rang skad cig gi he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par bsgom pa sku'i dga' ba/ shrī he ru ka a haṃ zhes brjod la de'i don dran par bya ba gsung gi dga' ba/ snying khar a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ bsgom pa thugs kyi dga' ba/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rang gi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi gyi bar 'od kyis mer gang bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs par bsam/ de yang grub chen gyi gzhung du/ nangs par sad pa dang mal nas langs te zhes pas sku'i dga' ba bstan/ shrī he ru ka a haṃ zhes brjod la de'i don dran par bya'o zhes pas gsung gi dga' ba bstan/ snying gar zla ba la dpal mchog dang po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin hūm̐ bsgom/ des sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyang ngo zhes pas thugs kyi dga' ba bstan/ dpal mchog dang po ni/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /zhes pa ltar ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi hūm̐ ni/ zhabs kyu bya ba grub pa dang / /zhes sogs sgrub thabs nas bshad pa ltar ro/ /rgyas par ni gzhan du bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa tshogs bsags dngos la/ tshogs bsags pa'i yul spyan drang ba/ de la phyag mchod sogs byed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ gzhung las/ sngon grub pa zhes gsungs pa ltar rang nyid kyi sngon rol tu lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur mkhan gyi bla ma gdod nas grub pa'i he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/

lus la lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor tshang ba khong rang gi bla ma rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa spyan drang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ na mo gu ru sogs kyis phyag dang / sarwa ta thā ga ta zhes sogs kyis phyi'i mchod pa lnga 'bul/ spro na yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa byas kyang rung ste/ rje btsun gyis/ gang yang rung bas mchod la zhes bshad pas so/ /mi spro na spros pa shin tu chung ba'i skabs yin pas cho ga chad pa'i skyon med do/ /de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams spyan drangs/ bla ma de spyi bor rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs par bsam/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi smin mtshams nas lus la zhugs pas phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched sbyangs shing byin gyis brlabs te rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du dus gcig tu wal gyis bskyed la rim gyis gsal gdab par bya'o/ /de ni grub chen gyi gzhung du/ 'od zer 'phros pas sngon grub pa/ /mchod nas phyag 'tshal rang lus gzhug /ces pa'i don to/ /bskyed rim dngos la/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa/ de la mchod pa dang bzlas pa'o/ /dang po la yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas su bskyed pa dang / de la mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du skad cig gis bskyed pa de gsal 'debs la/ rje btsun gyi dril bu lugs kyi sgrub thabs su/ rkang mthil rlung zhes pa nas/ mig la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan rta babs la sogs par mos pa bya'o zhes pa'i bar gyis lus dkyil gyi rten gzhal yas khang bsgom pa gsungs nas/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje zhes sogs srung 'khor ma bshad pa ni grub chen gyi gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi dgongs pa yin te/

gzhung las/ 'od zer 'phros pas sngon grub pa/ /mchod nas phyag 'tshal rang lus gzhug /ces pa'i rjes nas/ rkang mthil sum mdo lte snying ga /rlung me sa dang chu yin no/ /sgal tshigs ri rgyal de bzhin te/ /lus ni mnyam pa sgo bzhi rlung / /rgyan rnams kun mdzes he ru ka'i/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor du 'dod do/ /zhes grub chen gyi gzhung du bshad pas so/ /'gro mgon 'phags pas srung 'khor lus dkyil kha skong bar mdzad pa ni/ spyir sdom pa bshad par bde mchog gi srung 'khor lus dkyil bshad pa dang / skabs 'di'i rten lus dkyil ni/ sambu ṭar/ ji ltar rtsom chen la sogs pa/ /bla ma'i dus thabs rim nyid kyi/ /'di ni rdzogs par dkyil 'khor nyid/ /ces pa'i gzhung la brten pa yin la/ 'di ni rdzogs par dkyil 'khor nyid/ /ces pas phyi'i dkyil 'khor la chos ji snyed yod pa lus dkyil la yang yod par bshad pa dang / gzhung de la brten nas kyai rdor lus dkyil du yang srung 'khor lus dkyil mdzad la/ skabs 'di dang kyai rdor gyi rten lus dkyil gnyis brten pa'i rgyud kyang gcig yin la/ rgyud de'i dgongs pa 'chad tshul yang gcig pas/ srung 'khor lus dkyil kha bskangs kyang lhag pa'i skyon med cing shin tu legs pa yin no/ /de nas phyi'i he ru ka yab yum gsal gdab pa ni lū hi pa dang mthun par gsal 'debs sgrub pa po he ru kar bsgoms pa'i snying gar rtsa dbu ma la ro rkyang gnyis kyis dkris pas hūm̐ gi gzugs su gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang / de'i nang gi byang chub kyi sems yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam kha ba lta bur 'dzag pa yongs su gyur pa las he ru kar bskyed/ snying ga'i phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhi laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ bzhi'i gzugs su gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang / mtshams bzhi na bdud rtsi lnga 'dres pa 'bab pa'i rtsa bzhi la bum thod bzhi/

spyi bo pulli ra ma la yar/ rtsa mi phyed ma yi ge pu'i gzugs su gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las dpa' mo rab gtum mo dang / de'i nang na skra dang sen po rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i khams yongs su gyur pa las/ dpa' bo khaṇḍa ka pā li bskyed/ de yang spyi bo pulli ra ma ya 'di nyid phyi rol gyi rdo rje'i gnas chen pu li ra ma la ya de nyid yin no zhes yul la yul gyi zhen pa dang / dpa' bo khaṇḍa ka pā li dang / dpa' mo rab gtum mo 'di gnyis kyang phyi rol gyi rdo rje'i gnas chen pulli ra ma la ya na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo de nyid yin no snyam du lha la lha'i mos pa byed/ de bzhin du pus mo ku lun ta'i nang na rtsa yi ge ku'i dbyibs su gnas pa'i rtsa gdu bu ma dang / de'i nang na bu tsha'i brgyud pa rnams rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i khams gnyis las dpa' mo brtson 'grus chen mo dang / dpal bo rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis kyi bar du bskyed nas sngar bzhin yul dang lha'i zhen pa byed do/ /snying kha'i phyi skor la mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi/ sne mo g.yas g.yon gnyis las gcig phyogs su gyes/ gcig mtshams su gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab brgyad hūm̐ ring po'i gzugs su gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las sgo mtshams ma brgyad bskyed/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarwa wi ra yo gi nī zhes sogs pho nya gsum bsres byas nas go cha bcings la ye shes pa bstims pa dang dbang bskur nas/ gtso bo yab yum la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo la 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo la rnam par snang mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod pa drug gi dang po sngags mchod ni 'dir lū nag ltar rgyas par mi mdzad pas/ yab yum gyi snying po gnyis/

nye snying gnyis dang bzhi/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ pu dza u a sogs nyer bzhi dang / hūm̐ ring brgyad dang / oṃ ha na ma hi sogs go cha'i yi ge rnams brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni mchod pa bsang sbyangs la/ a bdun las thod pa bdun gyi nang du hūm̐ bdun zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon zhes sogs byin gyis brlabs la sngags tsam gyi phyi mchod/ gsum pa ni nang mchod byin gyis brlabs la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan la yi ge gsum btags pa dang / yi dam chos skyong sogs la rang gi sngags la 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang gi mchod pa dang / bdud rtsi myang zhing yi ge bdun ma brjod de 'khyud rgya dang bcas pas mnyes mchod/ na mo chos dbyings sogs phyag rgya dang bcas pas yid byung / yab yum gyi rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa'i mchod pa sogs rje btsun dang 'phags pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /de nas lha rnams kyi sngags rnams bzlas pas bsnyen pa ji ltar nus pa byas la bsrung ba dang dga' ba gsum dran pa sogs byas la spyod lam gyi bya ba la 'jug go /bstod pa'i mchod pa'i rjes sam bzlas pa'i rjes su rdzogs rim bsgom par bya zhing / thun mtshams su rjes spyod kyi rnal 'byor kyi nyams len dang / kha zas dang thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang ngo / /de dag gi ngag 'don dang rnam gzhag rgyas pa ni rje btsun gong ma rnams dang rjes 'jug gi gsung rab tshad ldan dag nas 'byung ba bzhin khong du tshud par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i lus dkyil gyi nyams len zab mo de nyid phyi dkyil rkyang pa las khyad par du 'phags tshul/ de nyid bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud rnams las khyad par du gsungs pa'i tshul/ de dag gi don gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ byin rlabs myur bas khyad par du 'phags pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skye bas khyad par du 'phags tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ lus dkyil bsgom pa'i sgrub pa po de la yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyis rlob par byed pa yin te/

yul 'di rnams kyi bu mo gang / /rtsa gzugs mdzes pas yang dag gnas/ /zhes pas sgrub pa po'i lus la mkha' 'gro ma rnams yang dag par gnas pas te/ de rnams kyi bskyed gzhi'am rgyur gyur pa'i rtsa rnams dngos su gnas pa'i phyir/ tshul ji ltar du byin gyis rlob ce na/ yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas rang gi nyams su myong ba'i yul da ltar gyi dus su yid la dran pa tsam gyis rnam pa 'char nus pa ltar yid kyi shugs kyis te/ yid la dran pa tsam gyis byin gyis rlob nus pa yin no/ /de rnams la de ltar byin gyis rlob pa'i nus pa yod dam snyam na/ de kun 'dod pa'i gzugs brnyan te/ /zhes gsungs pas 'dod pa'i gzugs can nam 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs can te bzhed pa tsam gyis gang 'dod du byin gyis rlob nus pa'o/ /'o na phyi dkyil rkyang ba las khyad par du 'phags na'ang phyi nang sbrags pa las khyad par du 'phags pa mi 'thad de/ de la'ang lus dkyil yod pas so snyam na'ang de yang spros pa'i tshogs che bas na lus dkyil gsal por mi 'char ba dang / lus dkyil 'bur dod du byas nas bsgom pa med pa dang / lus dkyil rdzogs par bsgom pa yang med pa'i phyir de bas kyang khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /gnyis pa phyi bskyed rim yang rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skye ba'i rgyur 'gro/ mngon byang lnga'i gnas su khams dkar dmar gyi sbyor bas bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed pa dang / rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum byang chub kyi sems kyi thig ler zhu ba las bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum snyoms 'jug byas te byang sems yum gyi mkhar babs te 'khor mngal 'byin gyi tshul gyis spro ba las bde stong gi ye shes bskyed pa yod pa'i phyir/ de lta na'ang de dang der mos pa tsam yin gyi sbyang gzhi yod par gnad du bsnun pa med pas bde stong gi ye shes brgyud nas skye ba'i rgyur 'gro ba tsam yin gyis dngos rgyur mi 'gro'o/

/lus dkyil la yang rags pa phung khams skye mched lhar bskyed pa'i lus dkyil gsang 'dus dang / rdo rje gdan gzhi'i phyi nang sbrags pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'khor lo bde mchog la'ang phung khams skye mched byin gyis rlob byed kyi lha rnams lus dkyil du byas pa yod kyang / bde stong gi ye shes kyi brgyud rgyur 'gro ba tsam yin no/ /phra ba rtsa khams lhar bskyed pa'i lus dkyil 'di lta bu ni rdzogs rim gyi ting nge 'dzin bzhin du bde stong gi ye shes kyi dngos rgyur 'gyur ba yin te/ rdzogs rim pa rnams la 'khor lo bzhi/ lte ba gtum mo'i ye shes kyi me/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig 'dzag pa rnams bsgom pa bzhin du sbyang gzhi la'ang de rnams yod cing / rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs dang thig le dang / me'i rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang yul nyer bzhi la sogs pa'i rtsa khams rnams la dmigs te bsgoms pa ltar/ sbyang gzhi la'ang rtsa khams de rnams gnas shing / rnam pa lhar bsgyur nas bsgom pa yin pa'i phyir/ de nas sbyang gzhi yod par gnad du bsnun pas byin rlabs myur ba dang / ye shes myur du skye bar 'gyur ba dang / lha'i rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom pas sgrub pa po'i lus byin gyis rlob par byed pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /'o na rdzogs rim gyi ting nge 'dzin dang khyad par med par 'gyur ro snyam na/ dbang po rnon po la ni khyad par med la/ dbang po rtul po la ni ye shes skye ba myur bul gyi khyad par yod do/ /'dir rlung gi sbyor ba med pas so/ /'o na thabs gang la brten nas rdzogs rim gyi ye shes ji ltar skye zhe na/ ba spu'i bu ga'i grangs kyi ni/ /rtsa rnams dbye ba phyed dang bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir sbyang gzhi la ba spu'i bu ga'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i rtsa bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi/ 'khor lo bzhi'i sgo nas dbye na brgya nyi shu/

byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa'i sgo nas dbye na sum cu rtsa gnyis/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi rten byed pa'i sgo nas dbye na ro rkyang kun 'dar ma gsum yod kyang / 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i dbang du byas na lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo raktas gang ba/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo byang chub kyi sems dkar pos gang ba/ snying ga'i dbus na pha ma gnyis las thob pa'i thig le dkar dmar sran ma tsa na ka'i tshad tsam gyi bar du/ shes pa'i rten rtsa dbu ma la ro rkyang gnyis kyis dkris pa'i hūm̐ gi rnam pa can 'phyang 'phrul du yod pa'i nang du gtum mo'i mes ma bcom pa'i dus su hūm̐ gi rnam pa can 'khyog po lngar gnas pa/ mes bcom pa na a shad kyi rnam pa lta bur gnas pa'i khams/ rtsa ro rkyang gnyis las snying ga'i nang skor phyogs bzhir rtsa bzhi rtse mor laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ gi yi ge'i gzugs su gnas pa bzhi ni/ skyes bu'i 'byung bzhi'i stobs rgyas pa'i rten byed/ mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi g.yas g.yon du gnyis gnyis gyes te snying kha'i phyi bskor la rtsa 'dab dmar po gtso cher khams dmar po rgyu ba brgyad/ smad du rtsa dkar shas che ba khams dkar po rgyu ba brgyad/ dang po thugs dang rjes su 'brel ba ste yid bskyed pa'i rgyu/ bar pa gsung dang rjes su 'brel ba ste ngag bskyed pa'i rgyu/ tha ma sku dang rjes su 'brel ba ste lus bskyed pa'i rgyu/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /tha ma 'bring dang dam pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ sku'i rtsa brgyad po der rlung sems 'dus na bde stong gi ye shes bskyed pa la tha ma/ gsung gi rtsa brgyad po der rlung sems 'dus na 'bring / thugs kyi rtsa brgyad po der rlung sems 'dus na bde stong gi ye shes bskyed pa la rab dam pa'o/ /snying kha'i phyi skor gyi rtsa 'dab brgyad la sgo mtshams ma brgyad bsgoms pas der rlung sems 'dus nas phyi rol tu 'jug pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa rags pa 'gag

sku'i rtsa brgyad du sku 'khor gyi lha brgyad bsgoms pas der rlung sems 'dus nas lus la brten pa'i kun rdzob rtog pa 'gag gsung 'khor gyi rtsa dmar po brgyad la gsung 'khor gyi lha bsgoms pas der rlung sems 'dus nas ngag la brten pa'i rnam rtog 'gag stod kyi rtsa sngon po brgyad la thugs 'khor gyi lha rnams bsgom pa la brten nas sems sems byung la brten pa'i gzung 'dzin rnam rtog 'gag snying kha'i phyogs bzhi'i rtsa 'dab bzhi la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi bsgoms pas der rlung sems 'dus nas gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa phra mo 'gag snying ga'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das yab yum bsgoms pas rlung sems dbu mar 'dus nas bde stong gi ye shes dngos su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa de nyid bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhung nas bshad pa'i tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud las sbas te gsungs pa'i tshul dang / bshad pa'i rgyud las rnam par 'thor te gsungs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gleng gzhi drang don du bshad pa la/ mngal skyes la sbyar ba/ sgong skyes la sbyar ba/ brdzus skyes la sbyar ba gsum las brdzus skyes la sbyar ba gtso bor ston cing / le'u lnga bcu pa las/ he ru ka dpal sku yan lag /kun tu brtan g.yo'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes pas he ru ka dpal gyi sku la brtan pa rnam par dag pa gzhal yas khang / g.yo bcud rnam par dag pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams 'god par bshad pa dang / pu la sogs pa gang bstan pa/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can du gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / le'u brgyad pa las/ thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /'gro ba 'di dag thams cad khyab/ /dpa' bo rnams dang mkha' 'gro nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rab gtum sogs/ /lus rnams kun la sgrub pa pos/ /'khor lo bzhugs par blta bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang / yul 'di rnams kyi bu mo gang / /rtsa gzugs mdzes par yang dag gnas/

/zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'gro kun don la rab gzhol ba/ /zhes sogs shlau ka gcig ni mngon spyod le'u bzhi pa las rten gyi gang zag bstan pa'i skabs nas gsungs te/ 'di nang gi bskyed rim bsgom pa'i rten gyi gang zag bstan pa yin pa ltar gsal lo/ /de nas nangs par sad pa dang / mal nas langs te zhes sogs ni/ he ru ka mngon 'byung las lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas spyod lam thams cad byed par bshad pa'i don thob las gsungs par gsal lo/ /de nas 'od zer 'phros pas sngon grub pa/ /zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis ni/ mngon spyod le'u dang po tshogs rten spyan 'dren gyi skabs nas btus pa yin te/ des lus dkyil gyi tshogs rten spyan 'dren bstan par gsal lo/ /de nas/ rkang pa gsum mdo lte snying ga /zhes sogs lus gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ sambu ṭa las/ rkang pa'i mthil du rtsom chen rlung / /zhes pa nas/ ri rab ri rgyal de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / ji ltar rtsom chen la sogs pa/ /bla ma'i dus thabs rim gnyis kyi/ /'dir ni rdzogs par dkyil 'khor gnas/ /zhes sogs kyis ston no/ /brten pa lha bskyed pa la/ sprul sku lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ phyi'i he ru ka la bskyed pa'i tshul/ ind+ra ni la mtshungs pa'i mdog /ces pa nas/ kha sbyor che nyid legs shes pas/ /zhes pa'i bar ni/ kun spyod le'u drug pa las/ rgyud du sbas pa nges par bya/ /rgyal chen shrī he ru ka nyid ni/ /gdug pa thams cad rab 'joms pa/ /phyag gnyis yang dag 'khyud pa dang / /gnyis kyis glang po'i pags pa 'dzin/ /dgra satwa mdung rtse gsum gri gug dang / /ḍa ma ru ni g.yas pas 'phyar/ /kha ṭwaṃ ga dang thod pa'i khrag /zhags pa mgo bo 'phyar ba ste/ /g.yon pa ru yi yan lag bshad/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i phyed kyis brgyan/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba mchod phyir thogs/ /brgya phyed par ni shes par bya/

/bcom ldan ma ni mdun bzhugs pa/ /zhal gcig 'bar ba chen mo ste/ /'khyud pa yi ni thod pa dag /gdug pa bdud kyi khrag can bsnams/ /g.yas pas rtag tu sdigs mdzub dang / /ma rung pa la gri gug bsnams/ /sku mdog dmar zhing cher 'bar ma/ /dum bus brgyan pa'i 'og lpags can/ /dbu skra grol zhing spyan gsum sku /mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing 'jigs/ /zhabs kyi byin pas legs par 'khyud/ /gnyis ka kha sbyor gnyis med bzhugs/ /zhes pa ltar bstan no/ /gnyis pa longs sku lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ lus kyi gnas nyer bzhi sogs su dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams 'god pa yin no/ /de la spyi bo zhes sogs kyis lha 'god pa'i gnas bstan la pulli ra ma la ya zhes sogs kyis yul la yul gyi zhen pa byed pa de ston/ 'o na phyi'i yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / lus kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi sbyor ba la shes byed ci yod/ med na spyi bo dza landha rar zhes sogs kyang sbyor rigs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du spyi bor khaṇḍa ka pā li dang rab gtum mo bsgom pa la shes byed ci yod/ med na spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo gnyis kyang bsgom rigs par 'gyur zhing / gnas de dang der dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma de bsgoms pas lus dkyil du 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ de la phyi'i gnas chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / lus kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi sbyor ba ni/ sambu ṭi'i brtag pa drug pa'i rab byed dang po las/ dza landha ra spyi gtsug tu/ /pu li ra ma la yi yul/ /zhes dang / kun spyod kyi le'u bcu gsum pa las/ pulli ma la ya mgo la/ /dza landha ra spyi gtsug nyid/ /u rgyan rna ba g.yas pa ste/ /ar bu ti ni rgyas tshigs so/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan/ nang gi gnas de dang der dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams 'god pa ni/

mngon spyod dgu pa las/ pu ste mgo bo la ni thod pa'i dum bu dang rab gtum ma'o/ /dza ste spyi gtsug la ni keng rus chen mo dang / gtum mo'i mig can ma'o/ /u ste rna ba g.yas pa ni keng rus can dang 'od ldan ma'o/ /u ste spyi bo'i rgyab la ni mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas so zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du mngon spyod kyi le'u gzhan rnams las kyang de ltar du gsungs pa ste tshan pa bcu gsum tsam 'byung / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las kyang de bzhin du gsungs so/ /gnas de dang der dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams bsgoms pas lus dkyil du 'gro tshul ni/ sambu ṭi las/ mi phyed ma ni ni spyi bor gnas/ /so dang sen mo 'bab par brjod/ /ces sogs kyis bstan no/ /nang gi rtsa rnams pu la sogs pa yi ge'i dbyibs su gnas pa ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro las gsungs so/ /sgo mtshams ma brgyad dpal nyin mdzad rdo rjes lag pa g.yon pa'i rtse mo khwa gdong ma/ mkhrig ma la 'ug gdong ma/ lag pa g.yas pa'i rtse mo la khyi gdong ma/ mkhrig ma la phag gdong ma/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i rtse mo la gshin rje bstan ma/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i rtse mo la gshin rje pho nya mo/ rkang ba g.yas pa'i long bu la gshin rje mche ba ma/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i long bu la gshin rje 'joms ma rnams 'god pa dang / phyag rdor stod 'grel du rkang sor brgyad la 'god par bshad kyang / 'dir snying ga'i phyi skor gyi rtsa 'dab la 'god pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las bshad/ bde chen 'khor lo'i lha bum thod dang bcas pa rnams snying kha'i phyogs mtshams kyi rtsa 'dab la 'god pa ni/ sambu ṭa las/ snying ga'i nang son padma ni/ /'dab brgyad lte ba snying por bcas/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan/ gsum pa chos sku lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs byang phyogs so bdun gyi dag pa ni/ mkha' 'gro kun spyod kyi le'u gnyis pa las gsungs/
